tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_rent_roll_to_revenue_reconciliation test: For multi-unit leased property, reconcile aggregate rental revenue to tenant/unit lease economics, including area, passing rent, reviews/escalation, abatements and occupancy status where material.

tier2.label: For material lease expiries, test the owner economics of renewal/reletting: downtime, rent reset, lost recoveries, tenant improvements/fit-out and leasing commissions.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_rollover_economic_vacancy test: For material lease expiries, test the owner economics of renewal/reletting: downtime, rent reset, lost recoveries, tenant improvements/fit-out and leasing commissions. Do not substitute a static physical-vacancy percentage for the actual economic vacancy when lease-level evidence exists.

tier2.label: Where monthly seasonality or occupancy profiles are used, determine whether a separate vacancy deduction represents a distinct risk or double counts the same expected lost revenue.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_vacancy_seasonality_double_count test: Where monthly seasonality or occupancy profiles are used, determine whether a separate vacancy deduction represents a distinct risk or double counts the same expected lost revenue.

tier2.label: For CAM/service-charge/expense recoveries, reconcile the recovery base to recoverable property expenses, occupied area/tenant allocation, caps/floors and vacancy leakage where applicable.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_recoveries_cam_basis test: For CAM/service-charge/expense recoveries, reconcile the recovery base to recoverable property expenses, occupied area/tenant allocation, caps/floors and vacancy leakage where applicable.

tier2.label: Identify material tenant concentration by rent, area, lease expiry, sector or guarantor strength.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_tenant_concentration_credit test: Identify material tenant concentration by rent, area, lease expiry, sector or guarantor strength. Where a major tenant drives value, assess the property cash-flow consequence of non-renewal/default rather than relying only on a generic bad-debt percentage.

tier2.label: For hotel/short-stay property, reconcile room revenue to available room nights, occupancy and ADR at the relevant room-type/period granularity.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_hotel_room_revenue_driver test: For hotel/short-stay property, reconcile room revenue to available room nights, occupancy and ADR at the relevant room-type/period granularity. Occupied room nights must not exceed available room nights.

tier2.label: Where hotel opening/ramp-up is material, test occupancy and ADR separately and preserve supported monthly/seasonal patterns.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_hotel_stabilisation_seasonality test: Where hotel opening/ramp-up is material, test occupancy and ADR separately and preserve supported monthly/seasonal patterns. Challenge a single escalation factor that masks distinct demand and rate dynamics.

tier2.label: Where cash-out refinance/recapitalisation is assumed, confirm the property has achieved the income/value condition used to size new debt, refinance costs and old-debt repayment are included, and extracted cash is trea...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_recapitalisation_cashout_refi test: Where cash-out refinance/recapitalisation is assumed, confirm the property has achieved the income/value condition used to size new debt, refinance costs and old-debt repayment are included, and extracted cash is treated as financing proceeds rather than operating income.

tier2.label: Where sale, refinance and partial-interest monetisation alternatives exist, confirm the model applies the actual sequence for the selected strategy and does not count the same property value through multiple independe...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_exit_path_consistency test: Where sale, refinance and partial-interest monetisation alternatives exist, confirm the model applies the actual sequence for the selected strategy and does not count the same property value through multiple independent full exits.

tier2.label: For sponsor/investor JVs, reconcile contributed capital, preferred return/hurdles, return of capital, tier splits and promote to the governing transaction terms.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_jv_waterfall_economic_terms test: For sponsor/investor JVs, reconcile contributed capital, preferred return/hurdles, return of capital, tier splits and promote to the governing transaction terms. Do not import example market percentages as defaults.

tier2.label: Reconcile operating, refinance and sale distributions through the JV waterfall to property-level cash actually available after senior property obligations required by the transaction.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_jv_distributable_cash_reconciliation test: Reconcile operating, refinance and sale distributions through the JV waterfall to property-level cash actually available after senior property obligations required by the transaction.

tier2.label: Where contamination, remediation or another site condition can affect the investment case, confirm the model reflects the supported cost/timing/use impact or clearly identifies the evidence needed.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_environmental_site_risk test: Where contamination, remediation or another site condition can affect the investment case, confirm the model reflects the supported cost/timing/use impact or clearly identifies the evidence needed. Do not assume a clean site solely because no allowance appears in the spreadsheet.

tier2.label: Test whether assumed rents, occupancy and exit quality are consistent with building age, deferred maintenance, major systems and refurbishment/amenity requirements.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_physical_appeal_lifecycle_capex test: Test whether assumed rents, occupancy and exit quality are consistent with building age, deferred maintenance, major systems and refurbishment/amenity requirements. Challenge prime economics that require reinvestment the model never funds.

tier2.label: Assess whether acquisition/cost basis is separated from operating property quality.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_entry_price_margin_of_safety test: Assess whether acquisition/cost basis is separated from operating property quality. A strong asset does not make an overpaid entry price economically safe; compare the return/value response to supportable entry-price variation.

tier2.label: Where terminal value is material, challenge the exit cap rate/yield against property quality, income durability, remaining lease term, capex burden and market context, and test downside rather than assuming the entry...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_exit_cap_rate_risk test: Where terminal value is material, challenge the exit cap rate/yield against property quality, income durability, remaining lease term, capex burden and market context, and test downside rather than assuming the entry yield persists.

tier2.label: Where the investment can be sold, refinanced or retained at different dates, assess whether the chosen holding period materially changes capex, lease rollover, income maturity, debt and exit value.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_holding_period_risk test: Where the investment can be sold, refinanced or retained at different dates, assess whether the chosen holding period materially changes capex, lease rollover, income maturity, debt and exit value. Do not treat a hard-coded hold as economically neutral.

tier2.label: Inspect property/equity cash flows for multiple sign changes caused by later capital calls, refurbishment, recapitalisation or other events.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_multiple_sign_change_return_metric test: Inspect property/equity cash flows for multiple sign changes caused by later capital calls, refurbishment, recapitalisation or other events. Where present, do not rely on a single IRR without a date-based NPV/value anchor and an explanation of any alternative return measure.

tier2.label: Where Monte Carlo/probabilistic analysis is used, confirm the selected property drivers, ranges, distributions and material dependencies are supported by evidence.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_probabilistic_driver_support test: Where Monte Carlo/probabilistic analysis is used, confirm the selected property drivers, ranges, distributions and material dependencies are supported by evidence. Sensitivity bounds are not probabilities.

tier2.label: Where a P(Gain) or similar probability-of-return-of-capital metric is used, verify the loss threshold, cash-flow definition and probability assumptions align with the actual investor/property economics.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_return_of_capital_probability test: Where a P(Gain) or similar probability-of-return-of-capital metric is used, verify the loss threshold, cash-flow definition and probability assumptions align with the actual investor/property economics. Treat the metric as supplementary, not a substitute for downside cash-flow analysis.

tier2.label: Where unit mix, use, pricing, leverage, density or holding period is optimised, confirm the proposed solution remains physically buildable, legally permissible, financeable and supportable by market absorption/demand.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_repositioning_optimisation_feasibility test: Where unit mix, use, pricing, leverage, density or holding period is optimised, confirm the proposed solution remains physically buildable, legally permissible, financeable and supportable by market absorption/demand. A mathematical optimum outside real property constraints is not decision-useful.

tier2.label: Map each material property area definition used by the model — for example gross/built, lettable, saleable, planning/GFA and site area — and reconcile the conversion/efficiency ratios.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_measurement_basis_consistency test: Map each material property area definition used by the model — for example gross/built, lettable, saleable, planning/GFA and site area — and reconcile the conversion/efficiency ratios. Confirm each cost, rent, sale-price and density rate is applied to the same measurement basis as its source evidence.

tier2.label: For material sales/rent comparables, test whether the model records enough context to distinguish recent arm's-length evidence from stale, related-party, bundled, sale-and-leaseback or otherwise less-direct evidence.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_comparable_weighting_and_transaction_context test: For material sales/rent comparables, test whether the model records enough context to distinguish recent arm's-length evidence from stale, related-party, bundled, sale-and-leaseback or otherwise less-direct evidence. Confirm weighting reflects relevance/reliability rather than a mechanical average.

tier2.label: Where retail evidence uses zoning/ITZA/frontage-depth analysis, confirm the subject property is measured and valued on the same local market convention.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_retail_zoning_basis test: Where retail evidence uses zoning/ITZA/frontage-depth analysis, confirm the subject property is measured and valued on the same local market convention. Do not impose zoning where the relevant market does not use it, and do not apply a zoned rate to undifferentiated whole floor area.

tier2.label: Identify whether each material yield is initial, reversionary, equivalent/implicit-growth, equated/explicit-growth or another market convention.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_yield_basis_taxonomy_consistency test: Identify whether each material yield is initial, reversionary, equivalent/implicit-growth, equated/explicit-growth or another market convention. Confirm the income, growth and timing basis used in the valuation is consistent with the way the yield was derived.

tier2.label: Where rent-payment timing is material, compare actual monthly/quarterly/half-yearly/annual and advance/arrears cash flows with the convention underlying the market yield/capitalisation factor.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_income_timing_yield_convention test: Where rent-payment timing is material, compare actual monthly/quarterly/half-yearly/annual and advance/arrears cash flows with the convention underlying the market yield/capitalisation factor. Require a coherent conversion where the bases differ.

tier2.label: For material lease incentives, reconcile headline rent to effective economic rent after rent-free periods, stepped rents, cash/fit-out contributions, service-charge concessions and other inducements.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_lease_incentive_effective_rent test: For material lease incentives, reconcile headline rent to effective economic rent after rent-free periods, stepped rents, cash/fit-out contributions, service-charge concessions and other inducements. Use a supportable analysis/write-off period and compare like-with-like rent evidence.

tier2.label: Where the subject lease has materially different rent-review frequency, break rights or lease length from comparable evidence, test whether the economic difference has been normalised or supported as immaterial using...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_abnormal_review_term_normalisation test: Where the subject lease has materially different rent-review frequency, break rights or lease length from comparable evidence, test whether the economic difference has been normalised or supported as immaterial using current market evidence rather than a universal textbook adjustment.

tier2.label: Where passing rent materially exceeds market rent, isolate the finite excess-rent cash flow and test default/re-letting, review/break/expiry and tenant-liability economics.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_overrented_reverse_premium test: Where passing rent materially exceeds market rent, isolate the finite excess-rent cash flow and test default/re-letting, review/break/expiry and tenant-liability economics. For onerous leaseholds, assess whether assignment/surrender requires a reverse premium or other compensation.

tier2.label: For surrender, renewal or material lease variation, compare landlord and tenant economic positions before and after the restructure.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_lease_restructure_before_after_economics test: For surrender, renewal or material lease variation, compare landlord and tenant economic positions before and after the restructure. Reconcile any rent change, incentive, capital contribution or premium needed to transfer value between the parties.

tier2.label: For sale-and-leaseback transactions, reconcile sale proceeds to the value of the interest actually sold and model the resulting leaseback rent, term, reviews/breaks, covenant, obligations and transaction costs.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_sale_leaseback_value_and_obligation test: For sale-and-leaseback transactions, reconcile sale proceeds to the value of the interest actually sold and model the resulting leaseback rent, term, reviews/breaks, covenant, obligations and transaction costs. Confirm released capital is not treated as a free benefit with no future occupancy cost.

tier2.label: Where combination of parcels or legal interests creates incremental value, value the standalone interests and the combination on a coherent basis, identify which party can realise the synergy and confirm the increment...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_synergistic_value_separation test: Where combination of parcels or legal interests creates incremental value, value the standalone interests and the combination on a coherent basis, identify which party can realise the synergy and confirm the increment is neither universalised to all buyers nor double counted.

tier2.label: For lending/security cases, identify the stated property valuation basis and any special sale assumptions.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_lending_security_realisability_basis test: For lending/security cases, identify the stated property valuation basis and any special sale assumptions. Keep market value separate from LTV/haircuts, and challenge collateral recoverability where buyer depth, specialisation, conversion cost or marketability limits realisation.

tier2.label: Where rent is turnover/percentage based, reconcile base/minimum rent, applicable turnover measure, percentage, thresholds, exclusions, caps/floors and reporting period to the lease economics.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_turnover_rent_contract_basis test: Where rent is turnover/percentage based, reconcile base/minimum rent, applicable turnover measure, percentage, thresholds, exclusions, caps/floors and reporting period to the lease economics. Do not treat operator-specific exceptional sales as ordinary property rent without support.

tier2.label: Where energy, flood, accessibility, building-services, climate-resilience or other current regulatory/ market requirements affect use or marketability, reconcile required capex/timing with rent, vacancy, economic life...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_regulatory_obsolescence_capex_value test: Where energy, flood, accessibility, building-services, climate-resilience or other current regulatory/ market requirements affect use or marketability, reconcile required capex/timing with rent, vacancy, economic life and exit value. Do not import a dated statutory threshold as a universal rule.

tier2.label: Where a residual development/site value is material and credible market evidence exists, compare the residual with comparable development-site transactions or another supportable market indicator.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_residual_market_crosscheck test: Where a residual development/site value is material and credible market evidence exists, compare the residual with comparable development-site transactions or another supportable market indicator. Investigate material divergence rather than accepting the residual solely because its arithmetic closes.

tier2.label: Where a property development relies on external capital, compare the assumed source, availability date, maturity and repayment profile with the actual development stage and property cash cycle.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_finance_source_stage_and_tenor_fit test: Where a property development relies on external capital, compare the assumed source, availability date, maturity and repayment profile with the actual development stage and property cash cycle. Challenge construction/stabilised-asset finance used before its conditions are supportable, and short-dated funding that expires before realistic completion, settlement or stabilisation without evidenced br...

tier2.label: For a model used to support funding, reconcile the financed scheme with the property evidence on which the capital provider relies, as applicable: land/title or acquisition rights, approvals/site clearance, feasibilit...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_financeability_evidence_package test: For a model used to support funding, reconcile the financed scheme with the property evidence on which the capital provider relies, as applicable: land/title or acquisition rights, approvals/site clearance, feasibility, site/geotechnical/topographical evidence, development cost/programme, market demand, pre-sales/pre-lets, prospective tenants and projected sales/rent/NOI. Do not impose a universal...

tier2.label: Map land deposits/settlement, planning, design, surveys, professional fees and other pre-development cash against the date the main development facility becomes effective/drawable.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_predevelopment_funding_gap test: Map land deposits/settlement, planning, design, surveys, professional fees and other pre-development cash against the date the main development facility becomes effective/drawable. Confirm sponsor equity, bridge or another credible source funds the period before senior construction finance is available.

tier2.label: Where pre-sales, pre-lets or off-taker commitments support financing, distinguish demand evidence from usable cash.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_presale_prelet_offtaker_bankability test: Where pre-sales, pre-lets or off-taker commitments support financing, distinguish demand evidence from usable cash. Reconcile qualifying commitments to the lender definition and model deposits/advance receipts according to refundability, escrow/trust restrictions, release conditions, cancellation/default and final settlement treatment.

tier2.label: Where land is contributed by a landowner/JV partner or paid on deferred/participating terms, reconcile the reduced upfront land cash with the actual consideration: deferred price, units, sale proceeds, preferred retur...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_landowner_jv_land_consideration test: Where land is contributed by a landowner/JV partner or paid on deferred/participating terms, reconcile the reduced upfront land cash with the actual consideration: deferred price, units, sale proceeds, preferred return, profit share or equity interest. Confirm the land contribution is neither omitted as 'free' nor double counted.

tier2.label: Where development debt is drawn against project progress, reconcile debt availability/draw timing with the contractual property conditions such as certified works, eligible cost, equity-first requirements, cost-to- co...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_construction_drawdown_progress_conditions test: Where development debt is drawn against project progress, reconcile debt availability/draw timing with the contractual property conditions such as certified works, eligible cost, equity-first requirements, cost-to- complete tests or lender-monitor approval. Do not assume the entire committed facility is usable from day one unless the actual terms permit it.

tier2.label: Compare financing approval, financial close and satisfaction of conditions precedent with land settlement, construction commitments and other unconditional project obligations.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_financing_timeline_commitment_alignment test: Compare financing approval, financial close and satisfaction of conditions precedent with land settlement, construction commitments and other unconditional project obligations. Challenge a funding case in which the developer becomes committed before sufficient bridge/equity/closed financing exists to meet those property obligations.

tier2.label: Where the model relies on a specific funding channel — bank development debt, mezzanine, REIT/equity, bond, public-sector support, high-net-worth/private capital or another instrument — test whether there is transacti...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_local_capital_market_availability test: Where the model relies on a specific funding channel — bank development debt, mezzanine, REIT/equity, bond, public-sector support, high-net-worth/private capital or another instrument — test whether there is transaction-specific evidence that the source is available for the jurisdiction, asset class, sponsor, size and stage. Do not use country survey rankings or another market's financing mix as a...

tier2.label: Where a model spans a material development/holding period, test whether occupier demand, vacancy, rent, yields, competing supply and development timing form a coherent property-cycle view.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_cycle_supply_credit_lead_lag test: Where a model spans a material development/holding period, test whether occupier demand, vacancy, rent, yields, competing supply and development timing form a coherent property-cycle view. Challenge a model that extrapolates strong current rents/low vacancy through delivery of new competing supply without considering the development lag.

tier2.label: Where refinance, extension or future debt availability is material, test the property-specific joint downside of weaker NOI, lower collateral value/higher cap rate and tighter financing availability.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_refinancing_market_cycle_joint_stress test: Where refinance, extension or future debt availability is material, test the property-specific joint downside of weaker NOI, lower collateral value/higher cap rate and tighter financing availability. Do not assume current leverage, spread or lender appetite automatically persists to the refinance date.

tier2.label: For a property/loan exposed to CMBS or another mortgage-backed structure, reconcile debt service and refinance risk to underlying tenant income, vacancy, NOI, collateral value, maturity structure and applicable tranch...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_securitisation_underlying_collateral_risk test: For a property/loan exposed to CMBS or another mortgage-backed structure, reconcile debt service and refinance risk to underlying tenant income, vacancy, NOI, collateral value, maturity structure and applicable tranche/payment priority. Confirm securitisation redistributes rather than eliminates the property risk.

tier2.label: Where commercial property debt leaves material principal due at maturity, test whether repayment depends on sale, refinancing or another evidenced source.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_balloon_extension_refinance_risk test: Where commercial property debt leaves material principal due at maturity, test whether repayment depends on sale, refinancing or another evidenced source. Assess extension risk where expected refinance proceeds may be unavailable because property income, value or credit-market conditions have weakened.

tier2.label: Where a listed property/REIT model uses both public-market value and direct-property NAV, keep property-level value, vehicle NAV and listed equity price separate.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_reit_market_price_nav_separation test: Where a listed property/REIT model uses both public-market value and direct-property NAV, keep property-level value, vehicle NAV and listed equity price separate. Confirm any premium/discount to NAV is not double counted as property cash flow or treated as an automatic correction to the underlying appraisal.

tier2.label: For cross-border property investment, reconcile local-currency property cash flows, debt currency, hedge mechanics and translation/repatriation to the investor reporting currency.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_crossborder_currency_return_basis test: For cross-border property investment, reconcile local-currency property cash flows, debt currency, hedge mechanics and translation/repatriation to the investor reporting currency. Do not claim diversification or home-currency return from local property returns without considering exchange-rate and market/institutional effects.

tier2.label: Where a model or valuation claims compliance/alignment with a property standard, identify the operative edition for the valuation date, jurisdiction, purpose and practitioner.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_standards_currency_and_status test: Where a model or valuation claims compliance/alignment with a property standard, identify the operative edition for the valuation date, jurisdiction, purpose and practitioner. Do not treat the 2026 IVS Exposure Draft, RICS consultation drafts or archived editions as binding current rules; apply local/national authority where it supersedes or supplements global guidance.

tier2.label: Where property evidence is thin, volatile or the valuation is highly sensitive, identify the principal sources of value uncertainty and test whether the precision/range presented is economically supportable.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_value_uncertainty_and_false_precision test: Where property evidence is thin, volatile or the valuation is highly sensitive, identify the principal sources of value uncertainty and test whether the precision/range presented is economically supportable. Keep genuine value uncertainty separate from actual modelling error; do not manufacture statistical confidence without a property-market basis.

tier2.label: Reconcile legal ownership/title area, planning site area and net development area where they differ.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_land_area_basis_and_density test: Reconcile legal ownership/title area, planning site area and net development area where they differ. Confirm density, land-value rates, infrastructure allocations, coverage and GDV use the correct denominator and that excluded/non-developable land does not acquire saleable/buildable economics.

tier2.label: For an explicit property DCF, test whether the forecast horizon is linked to lease events, stabilisation, refurbishment/redevelopment or another property rationale.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_dcf_forecast_period_and_terminal_reliance test: For an explicit property DCF, test whether the forecast horizon is linked to lease events, stabilisation, refurbishment/redevelopment or another property rationale. Quantify/review terminal-value reliance and reconcile exit value to forward NOI/rent, vacancy, capex, condition, remaining life and the exit yield at the terminal date.

tier2.label: Where rents or values use market/location growth, test whether asset-specific physical, functional and economic obsolescence is also reflected where material.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_market_growth_asset_depreciation_bridge test: Where rents or values use market/location growth, test whether asset-specific physical, functional and economic obsolescence is also reflected where material. Reconcile refurbishment/repositioning with any reset in relative rent, occupancy, useful life or exit yield; do not apply a universal annual depreciation rate.

tier2.label: Reconcile major cost rates/allowances to the scheme scope, area/measurement basis, design maturity, specification, location, procurement basis and price/base date.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_development_cost_prediction_basis test: Reconcile major cost rates/allowances to the scheme scope, area/measurement basis, design maturity, specification, location, procurement basis and price/base date. Confirm material development cost categories are classified consistently and required costs do not disappear through gross/net area or taxonomy changes.

tier2.label: For a scheme in progress, rebuild the economic cost to complete from completed/paid work, commitments, remaining works, variations/claims, known defects, remaining contingency, retentions/warranties and timing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_cost_to_complete_current_basis test: For a scheme in progress, rebuild the economic cost to complete from completed/paid work, commitments, remaining works, variations/claims, known defects, remaining contingency, retentions/warranties and timing. Do not accept original budget less spend as cost to complete when current project information has changed.

tier2.label: Where planning/entitlement risk is material, separate land/rights acquisition, entitlement advancement and irreversible construction commitment.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_entitlement_stage_optionality test: Where planning/entitlement risk is material, separate land/rights acquisition, entitlement advancement and irreversible construction commitment. Test whether the model preserves or destroys genuine wait/redesign/ phase/sell options and whether holding costs, approval expiry, tenure/option rights and other constraints make waiting physically and legally exercisable.

tier2.label: For a partially completed scheme, reconcile the modelled value to the exact stage reached, remaining time/cost, contractor/professional arrangements, claims/variations, warranties/bonds, outstanding consent conditions...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_development_in_progress_value_bridge test: For a partially completed scheme, reconcile the modelled value to the exact stage reached, remaining time/cost, contractor/professional arrangements, claims/variations, warranties/bonds, outstanding consent conditions, pre-commitments and remobilisation/deterioration risk. Do not use completed GDV less unspent budget as an unsupported proxy for work-in-progress value.

tier2.label: Identify what the residual appraisal solves for.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_residual_output_land_vs_developer_return test: Identify what the residual appraisal solves for. If land value is the output, reconcile GDV, all development/ finance costs and required developer return; if land cost is known, ensure developer profit/IRR is the output. Confirm target profit/return is not also buried as a duplicate cost allowance.

tier2.label: For recoverable property costs, reconcile lease/service-charge eligibility, allocation, caps/floors, vacancy leakage and recovery timing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_service_charge_recovery_timing_and_funding test: For recoverable property costs, reconcile lease/service-charge eligibility, allocation, caps/floors, vacancy leakage and recovery timing. Distinguish retained balances, forward funding, deferred recovery/payment plans and landlord bridge funding; do not treat ultimate recoverability as same-period cash receipt.

tier2.label: For material technical/site-condition findings, trace each relevant issue into the property economics — repair/ compliance capex, lifecycle spend, downtime, operating cost, useful life, marketability, insurance/financ...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_technical_due_diligence_cashflow_bridge test: For material technical/site-condition findings, trace each relevant issue into the property economics — repair/ compliance capex, lifecycle spend, downtime, operating cost, useful life, marketability, insurance/finance or redevelopment value. Do not add generic engineering allowances unrelated to the actual asset.

tier2.label: Where refurbishment/repositioning capex is material, reconcile spend and timing to the rent, occupancy, incentives, operating efficiency, economic life and/or exit yield benefits claimed.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_refurbishment_repositioning_value_bridge test: Where refurbishment/repositioning capex is material, reconcile spend and timing to the rent, occupancy, incentives, operating efficiency, economic life and/or exit yield benefits claimed. Test the converse case: removing or delaying the works should not leave post-refurbishment performance unchanged without evidence.

tier2.label: Where sustainability, energy performance or regulation is material to market participants, model the specific property pathways supported by evidence — retrofit/compliance capex, operating cost, rent/incentives, occup...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-property.md's property_sustainability_energy_value_pathway test: Where sustainability, energy performance or regulation is material to market participants, model the specific property pathways supported by evidence — retrofit/compliance capex, operating cost, rent/incentives, occupancy, legal lettability/use, financing/insurance or exit liquidity/value. Do not impose a universal green premium, brown discount or ESG haircut.

tier2.label: Compare final scheduled senior-debt repayment with concession/payment expiry and any required lender tail.

Confirm cash flows supporting debt service remain legally and operationally available for the full debt period.

tier2.label: For each contractual or financing reserve, verify target balance, funding, permitted draw, replenishment, interest, release and termination/refinancing/expiry treatment.

tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_distribution_lockup_and_trapped_cash test: Where finance documents impose distribution tests, verify shareholder distributions stop when tests/default conditions fail and that trapped cash is retained, swept, reserved or released exactly as the financing specifies.

tier2.label: Where financing economics are adjusted between bid and financial close, separate base-rate movement, lender margin, fees and hedging.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_bid_to_close_financing_adjustment test: Where financing economics are adjusted between bid and financial close, separate base-rate movement, lender margin, fees and hedging. Confirm only the risks retained or shared by the authority are neutralised through the contractual adjustment.

tier2.label: Where interest-rate hedging is material, reconcile hedge notional and tenor to debt exposure and test early refinancing/termination breakage economics where contractually relevant.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_interest_rate_hedge_debt_alignment test: Where interest-rate hedging is material, reconcile hedge notional and tenor to debt exposure and test early refinancing/termination breakage economics where contractually relevant.

tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_refinancing_gain_share test: For a contractual refinancing-gain mechanism, reproduce the prescribed before/after economics including fees, hedge breakage, reserve and leverage effects, then allocate the authority and shareholder shares through the required payment or cash mechanism without double counting.

tier2.label: Where project viability depends on refinancing or a mini-perm takeout, model refinancing timing, available tenor, pricing, debt capacity and downside/failed-refinancing consequences rather than assuming an automatic r...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_refinancing_dependency test: Where project viability depends on refinancing or a mini-perm takeout, model refinancing timing, available tenor, pricing, debt capacity and downside/failed-refinancing consequences rather than assuming an automatic rollover.

tier2.label: For material authority changes or compensation events, connect incremental capex/opex/lifecycle/schedule effects to the incremental funding requirement and financing cost, then apply the actual contractual compensatio...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_change_compensation_funding test: For material authority changes or compensation events, connect incremental capex/opex/lifecycle/schedule effects to the incremental funding requirement and financing cost, then apply the actual contractual compensation mechanism.

tier2.label: Where the contract requires financial rebalancing after a qualifying event, identify the exact protected metric or calculation basis and verify the model preserves that contractual position rather than an assumed gene...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_financial_rebalancing_metric test: Where the contract requires financial rebalancing after a qualifying event, identify the exact protected metric or calculation basis and verify the model preserves that contractual position rather than an assumed generic equity IRR.

tier2.label: Compare material PPP obligations against D&C/O&M subcontract protection for dates, standards, deductions, liability caps, relief events, indexation, lifecycle and handback.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_subcontract_risk_pass_through test: Compare material PPP obligations against D&C/O&M subcontract protection for dates, standards, deductions, liability caps, relief events, indexation, lifecycle and handback. Quantify retained SPV exposure where pass-through is incomplete.

tier2.label: Where the model serves the procuring authority, separately forecast government capital contributions, service payments, guarantees/support, retained costs, compensation events, termination exposure and handback/transi...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_authority_affordability_and_contingent_cashflow test: Where the model serves the procuring authority, separately forecast government capital contributions, service payments, guarantees/support, retained costs, compensation events, termination exposure and handback/transition obligations. Do not infer public affordability from private bankability.

tier2.label: For each material contractual/technical/financing assumption, identify the evidence that is authoritative for the model purpose and date.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_authoritative_document_maturity test: For each material contractual/technical/financing assumption, identify the evidence that is authoritative for the model purpose and date. Confirm executed/final terms have not been silently replaced by earlier bid, indicative or management assumptions where those terms were superseded.

tier2.label: Reconcile material legal/commercial, technical, demand/resource, cost/QS, insurance and financing adviser outputs to the financial model.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_cross_adviser_reconciliation test: Reconcile material legal/commercial, technical, demand/resource, cost/QS, insurance and financing adviser outputs to the financial model. Investigate differences in dates, scope, capacity, performance, cost, risk allocation or support rather than assuming the workbook is the source of truth.

tier2.label: Where a technical/operational model feeds the financial model, bridge physical outputs to financial inputs and test that aggregation does not remove economically material seasonality, peak, outage, loss, curtailment o...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_technical_model_financial_bridge test: Where a technical/operational model feeds the financial model, bridge physical outputs to financial inputs and test that aggregation does not remove economically material seasonality, peak, outage, loss, curtailment or commissioning constraints.

tier2.label: For material debt facilities, identify first-draw and subsequent-draw conditions that can affect construction funding.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_conditions_precedent_drawability test: For material debt facilities, identify first-draw and subsequent-draw conditions that can affect construction funding. Confirm debt is not drawn before required equity, project effectiveness, permits, insurance, security, hedging or other applicable conditions are satisfied.

tier2.label: Where a default/drawstop or failed draw condition can block future funding, confirm undrawn commitment is not treated as automatically available and that the project has a credible cure/support/replacement funding path.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_drawstop_undrawn_commitment test: Where a default/drawstop or failed draw condition can block future funding, confirm undrawn commitment is not treated as automatically available and that the project has a credible cure/support/replacement funding path.

tier2.label: For materially different financing tranches, reconcile currency, availability, draw order, maturity, amortisation, prepayment/sweep, reserves, ranking and refinancing treatment.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_multitranche_financing_intercreditor test: For materially different financing tranches, reconcile currency, availability, draw order, maturity, amortisation, prepayment/sweep, reserves, ranking and refinancing treatment. Confirm synthetic blending does not hide a tranche- specific funding or maturity constraint.

tier2.label: For a forecast financing breach, follow the actual contractual sequence through lock-up/cash trap, reserve or equity cure, waiver, prepayment, acceleration or enforcement as applicable.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_covenant_breach_cure_waiver test: For a forecast financing breach, follow the actual contractual sequence through lock-up/cash trap, reserve or equity cure, waiver, prepayment, acceleration or enforcement as applicable. Do not jump directly from ratio breach to termination.

tier2.label: Reconcile completion support, contingent equity, standby debt or other sponsor cure to committed amount, expiry, call conditions and purpose.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_sponsor_support_limit test: Reconcile completion support, contingent equity, standby debt or other sponsor cure to committed amount, expiry, call conditions and purpose. Confirm the model does not assume unlimited discretionary sponsor support.

tier2.label: Where lenders have direct agreements, reconcile notice, cure, step-in, substitution/novation and relevant time periods to default and termination scenarios.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_direct_agreement_stepin_sequence test: Where lenders have direct agreements, reconcile notice, cure, step-in, substitution/novation and relevant time periods to default and termination scenarios. Confirm termination cash flow is not triggered before lender rights are exhausted where those rights are exercisable.

tier2.label: For PCGs, bonds, LCs, LDs, guarantees, standby support and similar protections, model the applicable cap, expiry, call condition, recovery timing and counterparty.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_credit_support_recoverability test: For PCGs, bonds, LCs, LDs, guarantees, standby support and similar protections, model the applicable cap, expiry, call condition, recovery timing and counterparty. Prevent face-value contractual support from being treated as immediate unconditional cash.

tier2.label: For a material insured event, reconcile cover, limit, deductible, waiting period, business interruption, reinstatement and use of proceeds to the project downside.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_insurance_recovery_economics test: For a material insured event, reconcile cover, limit, deductible, waiting period, business interruption, reinstatement and use of proceeds to the project downside. Confirm insurance does not eliminate retained downtime or cash-flow loss.

tier2.label: Where a PPP contract has an insurance premium risk-sharing/review mechanism, reproduce the actual base-versus-actual cost, indexation, review period and sharing rules rather than applying generic inflation or full pas...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_insurance_premium_sharing test: Where a PPP contract has an insurance premium risk-sharing/review mechanism, reproduce the actual base-versus-actual cost, indexation, review period and sharing rules rather than applying generic inflation or full pass-through.

tier2.label: Identify material authority/offtaker/customer, EPC/O&M, supplier, insurer and grid/network counterparty exposures.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_counterparty_credit_concentration test: Identify material authority/offtaker/customer, EPC/O&M, supplier, insurer and grid/network counterparty exposures. Where project economics rely on one or a small number of counterparties, test the contractual support and cash-flow consequence of delayed/defaulted performance or payment.

tier2.label: Bridge local/foreign revenue, capex, opex and debt to contractual FX/index pass-through and hedges.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_fx_index_basis_risk test: Bridge local/foreign revenue, capex, opex and debt to contractual FX/index pass-through and hedges. Quantify residual lag, partial-indexation, cap/floor or basis exposure rather than assuming a CPI or FX clause creates a perfect hedge.

tier2.label: For an authority-side model, separate committed public payments from contingent guarantees/support.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_public_fiscal_direct_contingent test: For an authority-side model, separate committed public payments from contingent guarantees/support. For each material contingent liability, model trigger, timing, basis, cap, duration and interaction with project cash flows.

tier2.label: Where a PSC/reference/public-sector option is required, confirm it provides equivalent service quality, output, timing and whole-life maintenance to the private-finance option and applies the governing jurisdiction's...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_public_sector_option_equivalence test: Where a PSC/reference/public-sector option is required, confirm it provides equivalent service quality, output, timing and whole-life maintenance to the private-finance option and applies the governing jurisdiction's risk, tax and financing conventions consistently.

tier2.label: Where IFRS statutory statements and IFRIC 12 are in scope, reconcile grantor control/residual-interest conditions and the operator's rights to the financial-asset, intangible-asset or mixed model.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_ifric12_concession_classification test: Where IFRS statutory statements and IFRIC 12 are in scope, reconcile grantor control/residual-interest conditions and the operator's rights to the financial-asset, intangible-asset or mixed model. Keep accounting classification distinct from economic demand-risk allocation.

tier2.label: Reconcile critical path, float, interfaces, long-lead items, testing and acceptance to period capex, escalation, IDC, LDs/support and service commencement.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_construction_programme_financial_bridge test: Reconcile critical path, float, interfaces, long-lead items, testing and acceptance to period capex, escalation, IDC, LDs/support and service commencement. Confirm delay scenarios move only the costs/revenues causally affected.

tier2.label: Reconcile committed contract price, owner costs, escalation/FX, allowances, interface/commissioning costs, quantified risks, contingency and financing carry.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_construction_cost_contingency_stack test: Reconcile committed contract price, owner costs, escalation/FX, allowances, interface/commissioning costs, quantified risks, contingency and financing carry. Detect duplicated contingency/risk allowances or omitted cost scope.

tier2.label: For a partly constructed project, reconcile actual spend, committed remaining work, claims/variations, remaining contingency and schedule to current cost-to-complete and remaining funding.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_remaining_cost_to_complete test: For a partly constructed project, reconcile actual spend, committed remaining work, claims/variations, remaining contingency and schedule to current cost-to-complete and remaining funding. Do not apply an original-total-capex overrun percentage to already spent/fixed costs.

tier2.label: For an operating asset, reconcile original lifecycle plan to actual maintenance/renewal, current condition/defects and remaining lifecycle/handback works.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_lifecycle_actuals_condition_reconciliation test: For an operating asset, reconcile original lifecycle plan to actual maintenance/renewal, current condition/defects and remaining lifecycle/handback works. Determine whether apparent underspend is efficiency, deferral or under- maintenance.

tier2.label: Where senior debt matures before concession expiry, separately test remaining lifecycle, reserves/security, distributions, service performance and handback obligations after debt repayment.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_post_debt_handback_discipline test: Where senior debt matures before concession expiry, separately test remaining lifecycle, reserves/security, distributions, service performance and handback obligations after debt repayment. Confirm debt-free years do not create an unsupported maintenance holiday.

tier2.label: Build at least one material downside around causal dependencies — such as delay/IDC/LDs, outage/insurance/deductions, or low traffic/debt cover/augmentation — and confirm linked variables move coherently rather than a...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_correlated_downside_dependencies test: Build at least one material downside around causal dependencies — such as delay/IDC/LDs, outage/insurance/deductions, or low traffic/debt cover/augmentation — and confirm linked variables move coherently rather than as isolated or mutually inconsistent shocks.

tier2.label: For a power project, classify PPA/offtake revenue into capacity/availability, energy/output, take-or-pay, support and merchant components.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's power_ppa_revenue_component_classification test: For a power project, classify PPA/offtake revenue into capacity/availability, energy/output, take-or-pay, support and merchant components. Confirm each component responds to the contractual availability, dispatch, volume and price conditions that actually govern it.

tier2.label: Reconcile EPC completion, grid energisation, performance/reliability testing, PPA COD and final acceptance to revenue, LDs, debt milestones and operating obligations.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's power_cod_testing_acceptance test: Reconcile EPC completion, grid energisation, performance/reliability testing, PPA COD and final acceptance to revenue, LDs, debt milestones and operating obligations. Do not use one completion date for all triggers unless contractually correct.

tier2.label: Bridge renewable resource to gross generation and then through availability, technical/electrical losses, auxiliary load and curtailment to metered/saleable energy.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's renewable_resource_generation_loss_stack test: Bridge renewable resource to gross generation and then through availability, technical/electrical losses, auxiliary load and curtailment to metered/saleable energy. Reconcile probability/resource cases to the supporting technical study where available.

tier2.label: For thermal generation, reconcile net generation, heat rate/efficiency, auxiliary load, fuel quantity, fuel price/index and logistics.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's thermal_heat_rate_fuel_cost test: For thermal generation, reconcile net generation, heat rate/efficiency, auxiliary load, fuel quantity, fuel price/index and logistics. Confirm fuel-price pass-through does not also compensate project-controlled efficiency shortfall unless the PPA says so.

tier2.label: Separate project outage, resource shortfall, economic dispatch, grid constraint and offtaker curtailment.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's power_dispatch_curtailment_deemed_energy test: Separate project outage, resource shortfall, economic dispatch, grid constraint and offtaker curtailment. Apply deemed energy/generation compensation only to events, thresholds and measurement rules eligible under the PPA.

tier2.label: Reconcile interconnection/transmission completion, connection capacity and grid availability to plant COD and saleable energy.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's power_grid_interconnection_dependency test: Reconcile interconnection/transmission completion, connection capacity and grid availability to plant COD and saleable energy. Where grid delay/constraint is not project risk, apply the actual contractual relief/compensation rather than assuming physical output can be sold.

tier2.label: Reconcile degradation, forced/planned outage and major overhaul/replacement to generation, availability payment, O&M and lifecycle capex across the asset life.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's power_degradation_outage_overhaul test: Reconcile degradation, forced/planned outage and major overhaul/replacement to generation, availability payment, O&M and lifecycle capex across the asset life.

tier2.label: Where revenue depends on an offtaker/utility, reconcile payment security, LC/liquidity support, government guarantee or other credit enhancement to exposure, duration and call mechanics.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's power_offtaker_credit_support test: Where revenue depends on an offtaker/utility, reconcile payment security, LC/liquidity support, government guarantee or other credit enhancement to exposure, duration and call mechanics. Do not treat a fixed tariff as equivalent to creditworthy cash.

tier2.label: Where PPA/support expires before technical asset life, separate contracted and merchant periods.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's power_merchant_tail_support_expiry test: Where PPA/support expires before technical asset life, separate contracted and merchant periods. Confirm merchant prices, dispatch/curtailment and market exposure replace — rather than inherit — expired contractual protections.

tier2.label: Where project-borne, reconcile decommissioning/restoration/recycling obligations, timing, security/funding and residual asset/salvage assumptions to concession/lease expiry and technical end of life.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's power_decommissioning_restoration test: Where project-borne, reconcile decommissioning/restoration/recycling obligations, timing, security/funding and residual asset/salvage assumptions to concession/lease expiry and technical end of life.

tier2.label: For a heat/cooling network, bridge connected/contracted load through seasonality/diversity, peak demand, network losses and plant/backup dispatch to heat sold and input energy.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's heat_network_energy_balance_peak_capacity test: For a heat/cooling network, bridge connected/contracted load through seasonality/diversity, peak demand, network losses and plant/backup dispatch to heat sold and input energy. Confirm annual averages do not bypass peak-capacity or seasonal constraints.

tier2.label: Separate addressable buildings, signed/committed customers, connection timing, connected capacity, actual offtake and take-or-pay/minimum volume.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's heat_network_connection_offtake_ramp test: Separate addressable buildings, signed/committed customers, connection timing, connected capacity, actual offtake and take-or-pay/minimum volume. Prevent pipeline demand from being treated as contracted cash revenue.

tier2.label: Reconcile heat tariff/fixed-charge/indexation to fuel/electricity/carbon exposure, reset dates and caps/floors.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's heat_network_tariff_energy_basis_risk test: Reconcile heat tariff/fixed-charge/indexation to fuel/electricity/carbon exposure, reset dates and caps/floors. Quantify retained index/commodity basis risk and connect plant/network efficiency to variable input cost.

tier2.label: For each material project assumption, identify its maturity state at the model date — feasibility estimate, adviser base case, market-tested term, binding quote/commitment, executed contract or operating actual/curren...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_assumption_maturity_convergence test: For each material project assumption, identify its maturity state at the model date — feasibility estimate, adviser base case, market-tested term, binding quote/commitment, executed contract or operating actual/current evidence. Confirm a late-stage model uses the most mature applicable source without overwriting a contractual base case that remains legally relevant.

tier2.label: Where financing is long-tenor fixed-rate, heavily hedged or otherwise expensive to unwind, reconcile prepayment, make-whole, hedge close-out and related break costs to refinancing, variation, sale and termination scen...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_financing_certainty_flexibility_breakcost test: Where financing is long-tenor fixed-rate, heavily hedged or otherwise expensive to unwind, reconcile prepayment, make-whole, hedge close-out and related break costs to refinancing, variation, sale and termination scenarios. Compare financing structures on both affordability and flexibility where the difference is material.

tier2.label: For a material contractor/operator distress scenario with step-in or substitution rights, test whether a qualified replacement is practically available and model procurement/approval time, mobilisation, transition cos...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_replacement_contractor_practicality test: For a material contractor/operator distress scenario with step-in or substitution rights, test whether a qualified replacement is practically available and model procurement/approval time, mobilisation, transition cost, replacement pricing and recoveries where material. Do not make legal substitution economically instantaneous.

tier2.label: Run at least one representative worked event through each materially valuation-sensitive contractual mechanism that would otherwise remain dormant in the base case, such as payment deductions, tariff review, benchmark...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_contract_mechanism_representative_event test: Run at least one representative worked event through each materially valuation-sensitive contractual mechanism that would otherwise remain dormant in the base case, such as payment deductions, tariff review, benchmarking, compensation, refinancing gain share or termination. Confirm thresholds, lags, caps, sharing and cure logic reproduce the contract.

tier2.label: For a material user-pay concession/utility, reconcile service scope and whole-life cost/financing requirement to tariff, affordability/willingness to pay, demand/collection and any residual subsidy/VGF/support.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's userpay_tariff_service_affordability_support_loop test: For a material user-pay concession/utility, reconcile service scope and whole-life cost/financing requirement to tariff, affordability/willingness to pay, demand/collection and any residual subsidy/VGF/support. Prevent tariff from acting as an unsupported plug independent of customer response and public affordability.

tier2.label: For a material government guarantee, model contractual maximum exposure and a proportionate view of expected/severe downside exposure and timing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_government_guarantee_risk_profile test: For a material government guarantee, model contractual maximum exposure and a proportionate view of expected/severe downside exposure and timing. Where data and materiality justify it, use probability-weighted, stochastic, option-style or other appropriate valuation as a cross-check; do not require complex methods when the evidence cannot support them.

tier2.label: For a material transferred/shared risk, identify which party controls the decisions that change exposure or sensitivity to that risk.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_risk_decision_right_alignment test: For a material transferred/shared risk, identify which party controls the decisions that change exposure or sensitivity to that risk. Confirm the contract/model contains approvals, caps, sharing or retained-risk mechanisms that prevent a protected party from increasing another party's exposure without economic consequence.

tier2.label: Where procurement prescribed common assumptions for bid comparability, distinguish those assumptions from bidder-owned commercial risks.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_common_vs_bidder_owned_assumptions test: Where procurement prescribed common assumptions for bid comparability, distinguish those assumptions from bidder-owned commercial risks. At financial close, reconcile which values remain contractual/common, which are reset, and which have been superseded by executed supplier/financing terms.

tier2.label: Where strategic sponsor/operator equity retention or transfer restrictions apply, reconcile permitted sell-down dates/levels to completion support, guarantees, operating capability and distributions/refinancing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_sponsor_retention_equity_transfer test: Where strategic sponsor/operator equity retention or transfer restrictions apply, reconcile permitted sell-down dates/levels to completion support, guarantees, operating capability and distributions/refinancing. Confirm sponsor support is not assumed to survive a transfer unless the obligation actually does.

tier2.label: For a material concession renegotiation/restructuring, preserve the pre-renegotiation baseline and bridge all revised tariff/ payment, term, support, debt, equity and risk-allocation changes to the post-renegotiation...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_renegotiation_value_risk_bridge test: For a material concession renegotiation/restructuring, preserve the pre-renegotiation baseline and bridge all revised tariff/ payment, term, support, debt, equity and risk-allocation changes to the post-renegotiation economics. Quantify the resulting value/risk transfer between authority, users, lenders and shareholders.

tier2.label: Classify material post-close changes as pre-agreed contractual adjustment, contractual compensation/rebalancing, or true renegotiation.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_adjustment_vs_renegotiation_classification test: Classify material post-close changes as pre-agreed contractual adjustment, contractual compensation/rebalancing, or true renegotiation. Apply the correct economic baseline and entitlement; do not treat a discretionary concession as an automatic contractual right or vice versa.

tier2.label: Where government guarantees, debt underpinning or other credit support protects lenders/investors, identify the portion of capital genuinely exposed to project performance and the contingent public exposure.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_credit_support_private_downside_retention test: Where government guarantees, debt underpinning or other credit support protects lenders/investors, identify the portion of capital genuinely exposed to project performance and the contingent public exposure. Confirm the model does not equate heavy protection with unchanged private risk transfer or standalone project-cash-flow bankability.

tier2.label: For a material service/performance failure, map payment deductions, performance points, LDs/damages and other financial remedies to the contract's interaction/no-double-remedy rules.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_payment_remedy_no_double_recovery test: For a material service/performance failure, map payment deductions, performance points, LDs/damages and other financial remedies to the contract's interaction/no-double-remedy rules. Confirm the same economic loss is not recovered twice and that a distinct remedy is not incorrectly suppressed merely because another mechanism also applies.

tier2.label: Where persistent-breach/default provisions are material, reproduce the warning, final-warning, cure/recurrence periods, lender cure/step-in and termination sequence.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_persistent_breach_default_sequence test: Where persistent-breach/default provisions are material, reproduce the warning, final-warning, cure/recurrence periods, lender cure/step-in and termination sequence. Confirm repeated minor failure neither triggers premature termination nor remains forever limited to small deductions when the contract provides an escalation path.

tier2.label: Where revenue is service/performance based, confirm scheduled debt service, interest or finance charges are not carved out from deductions or guaranteed by the payment mechanism unless the contract expressly provides...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_payment_finance_charge_ringfence test: Where revenue is service/performance based, confirm scheduled debt service, interest or finance charges are not carved out from deductions or guaranteed by the payment mechanism unless the contract expressly provides that protection. tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_coverage_horizon_break_even test: Interpret DSCR, LLCR and PLCR against their matching debt-service, loan-life and project-life cash-flow horizons.
