tier2.label: For multiple sculpted/cash-flow-sized debt issues, reconcile tranche-specific tenor, rate/fees, capture rights, amortisation, average life, balloons, WHT/PRI/guarantee costs, reserves and hedge requirements.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_multitranche_sculpting_constraints test: For multiple sculpted/cash-flow-sized debt issues, reconcile tranche-specific tenor, rate/fees, capture rights, amortisation, average life, balloons, WHT/PRI/guarantee costs, reserves and hedge requirements. Do not allocate aggregate debt service pro rata where tranche economics differ; identify which gearing/coverage/tail/average-life/market constraint actually binds.

tier2.label: Where lender debt sizing references P50/P90/P99 or other probabilistic resource/output cases, reproduce the exact lender case and CFADS perimeter.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_resource_case_debt_sizing test: Where lender debt sizing references P50/P90/P99 or other probabilistic resource/output cases, reproduce the exact lender case and CFADS perimeter. Keep probabilistic resource cases distinct from arbitrary sensitivities and do not import a probability case into debt sizing if the financing documents do not use it.

tier2.label: Reconcile actual sponsor cash equity to any lender-defined equity/project-cost credit for pre-COD income, development/owner fees, shareholder loans, capitalised financing cost, grants or other non-cash items.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_deemed_equity_noncash_costs test: Reconcile actual sponsor cash equity to any lender-defined equity/project-cost credit for pre-COD income, development/owner fees, shareholder loans, capitalised financing cost, grants or other non-cash items. Prevent one amount from being counted as external project spend, sponsor cash equity and sponsor income simultaneously.

tier2.label: Where DSRA may be cash-funded or provided by LC/reserve facility, reconcile required amount, funding/collateral, provider credit, fee, draw, expiry, reinstatement, replenishment and release.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_dsra_cash_vs_lc test: Where DSRA may be cash-funded or provided by LC/reserve facility, reconcile required amount, funding/collateral, provider credit, fee, draw, expiry, reinstatement, replenishment and release. Prevent LC support from being treated as unrestricted cash and cash DSRA from being counted as distributable while reserved.

tier2.label: For a major-maintenance/lifecycle reserve, separate reserve deposits/releases from the actual maintenance/renewal expenditure and its physical timing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_mra_reserve_vs_maintenance_spend test: For a major-maintenance/lifecycle reserve, separate reserve deposits/releases from the actual maintenance/renewal expenditure and its physical timing. Reconcile CFADS/tax treatment and prevent double-counting reserve funding and lifecycle spend as two economic costs unless the finance documents require both cash outflows.

tier2.label: For cash sweeps and lock-ups, distinguish stress-period distribution traps from good-period cash capture.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_cash_sweep_risk_appropriateness test: For cash sweeps and lock-ups, distinguish stress-period distribution traps from good-period cash capture. Test sweep benefit under the project's actual volatility/downtrend scenarios and do not credit a sweep as automatic protection where there is little excess cash to capture or cash flow is already stable.

tier2.label: Where CFADS cannot meet scheduled debt service, reproduce reserve/liquidity draws, unpaid principal/interest, default interest, cure/waiver, mandatory prepayment, acceleration or enforcement as applicable.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_debt_service_shortfall_arrears test: Where CFADS cannot meet scheduled debt service, reproduce reserve/liquidity draws, unpaid principal/interest, default interest, cure/waiver, mandatory prepayment, acceleration or enforcement as applicable. Prevent scheduled debt service shortfalls from disappearing or later cash from bypassing actual arrears.

tier2.label: Reconcile construction draws, amortisation, cash-sweep/prepayment and debt maturity to hedge notional and tenor.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_hedge_profile_average_life test: Reconcile construction draws, amortisation, cash-sweep/prepayment and debt maturity to hedge notional and tenor. Use average debt life only as a summary/approximation; test extension, contraction and over-/under-hedging plus breakage on early repayment, refinancing or termination.

tier2.label: Where debt margins step up, retain the executed step-up in the no-refinancing case and separately model any refinancing assumption with availability, fees, hedge breakage, reserves and PPP gain-sharing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_stepup_margin_refinancing_case test: Where debt margins step up, retain the executed step-up in the no-refinancing case and separately model any refinancing assumption with availability, fees, hedge breakage, reserves and PPP gain-sharing. Do not delete a contractual margin step-up merely because refinancing is commercially desirable.

tier2.label: For a live construction project, reconcile actual/certified spend, WIP/accruals, current cost-to-complete, actual debt/equity/public funding, undrawn legally available commitments and remaining support.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's construction_actual_remaining_cost_finance test: For a live construction project, reconcile actual/certified spend, WIP/accruals, current cost-to-complete, actual debt/equity/public funding, undrawn legally available commitments and remaining support. Reprofile only the remaining construction and funding under the executed funding rule; do not rescale historic actuals to preserve original gearing.

tier2.label: Distinguish pure completion/acceptance delay after substantial spend from delayed physical construction progress.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's construction_delay_type_spend_profile test: Distinguish pure completion/acceptance delay after substantial spend from delayed physical construction progress. Apply the corresponding capex, site/escalation, IDC and revenue consequences rather than automatically shifting or freezing the whole construction S-curve for every delay case.

tier2.label: For a sale/refinancing/valuation at an intermediate project stage, identify risks actually resolved and remaining across permits, construction, acceptance, demand/resource, O&M/lifecycle, counterparty, regulatory, mer...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_stage_dependent_risk_exit_value test: For a sale/refinancing/valuation at an intermediate project stage, identify risks actually resolved and remaining across permits, construction, acceptance, demand/resource, O&M/lifecycle, counterparty, regulatory, merchant and handback. Use buyer/discount assumptions consistent with the remaining risk rather than a generic mature-infrastructure return or historical transaction multiple.

tier2.label: Keep unlevered/project return distinct from sponsor/equity return and explain leverage, taxes, fees, reserves, subordinated instruments, distribution timing and refinancing effects.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_project_vs_equity_return_diagnostic test: Keep unlevered/project return distinct from sponsor/equity return and explain leverage, taxes, fees, reserves, subordinated instruments, distribution timing and refinancing effects. Investigate counterintuitive return relationships rather than forcing a generic leverage rule.

tier2.label: For a PPP programme/portfolio model, aggregate scheduled payments and expected contingent support while preserving correlated macro, demand, termination and guarantee risks.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_authority_portfolio_fiscal_exposure test: For a PPP programme/portfolio model, aggregate scheduled payments and expected contingent support while preserving correlated macro, demand, termination and guarantee risks. Reconcile annual/medium-term budget/fiscal constraints and do not assess individually affordable projects as if authority capacity were unlimited across the portfolio.

tier2.label: Where the contracting authority is municipal/subnational or a utility, reconcile payment capacity to its actual revenues, transfers, borrowing/fiscal limits, credit enhancement and any legally enforceable higher-gover...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_subnational_payer_credit test: Where the contracting authority is municipal/subnational or a utility, reconcile payment capacity to its actual revenues, transfers, borrowing/fiscal limits, credit enhancement and any legally enforceable higher-government support. Do not assume sovereign credit merely because the project is public infrastructure.

tier2.label: Where conflict/state fragility is material, trace security, access/supply-chain, payer, permit/customs, FX transfer, expropriation/change, insurance/PRI and lender drawstop/termination pathways.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_fragile_conflict_political_risk_pathway test: Where conflict/state fragility is material, trace security, access/supply-chain, payer, permit/customs, FX transfer, expropriation/change, insurance/PRI and lender drawstop/termination pathways. Reconcile support instruments to eligible risks, caps, tenor and claim timing rather than applying a generic country-risk haircut or blanket DFI protection.

tier2.label: For a multi-part PPA/offtake tariff, reconcile capacity/fixed O&M/energy or fuel/heat-rate/start-up/performance components and penalties to physical output and project cost.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_multicomponent_tariff_backtoback_guarantees test: For a multi-part PPA/offtake tariff, reconcile capacity/fixed O&M/energy or fuel/heat-rate/start-up/performance components and penalties to physical output and project cost. Compare PPA protections with EPC/O&M/fuel-supply guarantees for timing, caps, definitions, indexation and counterparty credit; do not assume perfect pass-through.

tier2.label: For public-private joint ventures or hybrids, decompose shareholder, regulator, authority/offtaker, grantor and operator roles and the component payment/risk allocation.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_hybrid_jv_role_conflict test: For public-private joint ventures or hybrids, decompose shareholder, regulator, authority/offtaker, grantor and operator roles and the component payment/risk allocation. Challenge tariff, dividend, subsidy or investment assumptions that rely on government acting in one role while ignoring conflicting duties in another.

tier2.label: For each material modelled tariff/payment/approval/security/termination right, confirm the responsible authority/regulator and legal route can implement it and that required permits/licences/foreign ownership/FX-trans...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_legal_regulatory_economic_enforceability test: For each material modelled tariff/payment/approval/security/termination right, confirm the responsible authority/regulator and legal route can implement it and that required permits/licences/foreign ownership/FX-transfer conditions are consistent with the model. Convert only material unresolved institutional constraints into timing/cash-flow risk; do not apply a generic legal-risk haircut.

tier2.label: Where a PPP is unsolicited or directly negotiated, challenge any claim that proponent capex, tariff/payment, financing or return is market- tested.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_unsolicited_direct_negotiation_market_test test: Where a PPP is unsolicited or directly negotiated, challenge any claim that proponent capex, tariff/payment, financing or return is market- tested. Reconcile value-for-money/commercial reasonableness to the jurisdiction's permitted benchmark, independent evidence or competitive challenge, keeping any IP/development compensation separate from core project economics.

tier2.label: Where sponsor/investor distributions change at return hurdles, reproduce dated contribution/distribution basis, hurdle metric, cumulative tracking, incremental allocation, catch-up/clawback and treatment of shareholde...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's infrastructure_equity_promote_irr_flip_waterfall test: Where sponsor/investor distributions change at return hurdles, reproduce dated contribution/distribution basis, hurdle metric, cumulative tracking, incremental allocation, catch-up/clawback and treatment of shareholder debt/refinancing/sale proceeds. Prevent constant ownership percentages from overriding contractual flips and keep developer promote return distinct from project return.

tier2.label: For generation projects, reconcile LCOE/levelised cost and per-unit cost benchmarks to consistent net capacity/energy, nominal/real basis, asset life, discount basis and included capex/O&M/fuel/lifecycle/grid/carbon s...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_lcoe_cost_driver_benchmark test: For generation projects, reconcile LCOE/levelised cost and per-unit cost benchmarks to consistent net capacity/energy, nominal/real basis, asset life, discount basis and included capex/O&M/fuel/lifecycle/grid/carbon scope. Explain differences through project-specific technology, resource, geography and operating drivers rather than applying generic industry averages.

tier2.label: Where network-service take-up is constrained by connection cost or collection design, separate connection/access charge from recurring tariff, reflect approved subsidy/instalment/service-tier mechanisms and quantify p...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's userpay_connection_affordability_collection_design test: Where network-service take-up is constrained by connection cost or collection design, separate connection/access charge from recurring tariff, reflect approved subsidy/instalment/service-tier mechanisms and quantify prepaid/payment-point/billing changes where material. tier2.label: For sovereign/public infrastructure, distinguish economic viability, intrinsic project financial viability and entity/service financial sustainability.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_project_entity_sustainability_perimeter test: For sovereign/public infrastructure, distinguish economic viability, intrinsic project financial viability and entity/service financial sustainability. Identify the actual O&M entity and test the appropriate network/service perimeter rather than assuming project-level viability proves sustainable service delivery.

tier2.label: For a budget-funded public operator, compare technical/normative **unconstrained** network O&M and replacement needs with budget allocation and actual execution.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_network_unconstrained_om_budget_execution test: For a budget-funded public operator, compare technical/normative **unconstrained** network O&M and replacement needs with budget allocation and actual execution. Fail any conclusion based only on the small size of incremental project O&M relative to total budget where the existing network is materially underfunded.

tier2.label: Where O&M funding/execution is below required levels, trace maintenance backlog into asset condition, service, rehabilitation/renewal need and economic life.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_om_backlog_asset_life test: Where O&M funding/execution is below required levels, trace maintenance backlog into asset condition, service, rehabilitation/renewal need and economic life. Do not preserve full design life and service quality without an evidence-based mitigation path.

tier2.label: Identify the entity or entities responsible for post-completion O&M.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_responsible_om_agency_funding test: Identify the entity or entities responsible for post-completion O&M. Where construction responsibility and O&M responsibility differ, assess the latter's recurrent funding/fiscal capacity and inter-agency transfer mechanism.

tier2.label: For a corporatised/public utility, test whole-network historic and projected sustainability using relevant tariff, collection, loss/NRW, subsidy, cross-subsidy, debt and replacement drivers.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_utility_network_financial_sustainability test: For a corporatised/public utility, test whole-network historic and projected sustainability using relevant tariff, collection, loss/NRW, subsidy, cross-subsidy, debt and replacement drivers. Do not infer sustainability from the new project's standalone returns.

tier2.label: For a project described as intrinsically financially viable, identify whether cost recovery depends on predictable/enforceable project cash flows or on annual/discretionary subsidy.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's predictable_vs_discretionary_support test: For a project described as intrinsically financially viable, identify whether cost recovery depends on predictable/enforceable project cash flows or on annual/discretionary subsidy. If discretionary support is required, test government fiscal capacity and classify the project as support-dependent rather than self-financing.

tier2.label: Where the governing development-finance methodology uses separate real project evaluation and nominal entity financial analysis, confirm each cash-flow stream, inflation basis, tax treatment, presentation currency and...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's institutional_real_project_vs_nominal_entity_basis test: Where the governing development-finance methodology uses separate real project evaluation and nominal entity financial analysis, confirm each cash-flow stream, inflation basis, tax treatment, presentation currency and discount/capital-cost measure are internally consistent. Do not mix real FIRR cash flows with nominal capital cost.

tier2.label: Where a project financial cost-benefit/FIRR evaluation is required, confirm expansion/replacement cash flows are incremental to a credible without-project case.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's incremental_project_financial_counterfactual test: Where a project financial cost-benefit/FIRR evaluation is required, confirm expansion/replacement cash flows are incremental to a credible without-project case. Include required O&M, replacements/periodic maintenance and closure/restoration on the prescribed perimeter and avoid financing items the methodology expressly excludes.

tier2.label: For material tariff/user-fee/toll assumptions in a public/project financial-sustainability case, test legal/regulatory authority, price-setting objective, historic adjustment behaviour, affordability/elasticity, cost-...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_tariff_toll_achievability test: For material tariff/user-fee/toll assumptions in a public/project financial-sustainability case, test legal/regulatory authority, price-setting objective, historic adjustment behaviour, affordability/elasticity, cost-recovery basis and cash collection. Challenge automatic model- solving tariff escalation unsupported by the governing framework.

tier2.label: Where WACC is used for project financial evaluation, trace it to the project financing plan and relevant economic cost of each source, including fees and opportunity cost where the methodology requires it.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_wacc_not_equity_hurdle_or_vfm test: Where WACC is used for project financial evaluation, trace it to the project financing plan and relevant economic cost of each source, including fees and opportunity cost where the methodology requires it. Keep it distinct from sponsor equity hurdle, social discount rate, PSC/VfM discount rate and entity corporate WACC.

tier2.label: Where FNPV/FIRR or equivalent project-financial thresholds are used, calculate or review switching values for the most material drivers where useful.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's financial_switching_value_resilience test: Where FNPV/FIRR or equivalent project-financial thresholds are used, calculate or review switching values for the most material drivers where useful. Use the correct threshold/perimeter and do not interpret the switching value as a probability of default.

tier2.label: Identify materially correlated financial-risk drivers and test them jointly in plausible scenarios where appropriate, such as construction delay with cost escalation/delayed benefits or tariff increases with demand re...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's correlated_financial_risk_scenarios test: Identify materially correlated financial-risk drivers and test them jointly in plausible scenarios where appropriate, such as construction delay with cost escalation/delayed benefits or tariff increases with demand response. Avoid additive double counting and non-diagnostic 'kitchen-sink' stress cases.

tier2.label: For public/development-finance covenants, confirm each material covenant is measurable, monitorable, achievable and materially within the responsible entity's control.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_financial_covenant_controllability test: For public/development-finance covenants, confirm each material covenant is measurable, monitorable, achievable and materially within the responsible entity's control. Do not covenant external demand, legislative appropriation or independent regulator decisions as though they were controllable actions.

tier2.label: Distinguish one-time conditions, continuing performance covenants and prior-consent restrictions.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_covenant_type_and_early_warning test: Distinguish one-time conditions, continuing performance covenants and prior-consent restrictions. Where forecast non-compliance emerges, identify the intended early-warning/mitigation path and do not use waivers or model assumptions as automatic cures.

tier2.label: Where material design, scope, financing, tariff/support, O&M entity or going-concern conditions change, determine whether the governing authority/lender methodology requires financial re-evaluation and update the viab...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's implementation_financial_reevaluation_trigger test: Where material design, scope, financing, tariff/support, O&M entity or going-concern conditions change, determine whether the governing authority/lender methodology requires financial re-evaluation and update the viability/sustainability conclusion accordingly.

tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's electricity_utility_support_and_loss_sustainability test: For a public electricity operator, connect tariff setting/revision, renewable-support obligations, government compensation, technical and commercial losses, metering, billing/collection and subsidy receipt to operator sustainability. Do not assume a bankable generator tariff means the purchasing utility can fund it.

tier2.label: For public/toll roads, determine whether tolls are retained by the operator or remitted to government.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's public_road_toll_retention_and_om_funding test: For public/toll roads, determine whether tolls are retained by the operator or remitted to government. If retained, test toll adequacy for O&M/ capital service; if remitted, test budget allocation/execution against unconstrained road-network O&M rather than treating gross tolls as operator cash.

tier2.label: For social/urban service infrastructure where full user-pay cost recovery is not realistic, test recurrent service/O&M funding and the relevant government or purchasing-agency fiscal capacity.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's social_service_recurrent_fiscal_capacity test: For social/urban service infrastructure where full user-pay cost recovery is not realistic, test recurrent service/O&M funding and the relevant government or purchasing-agency fiscal capacity. Do not treat construction financing as proof that long-run service delivery is funded.

tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's vfm_relative_value_affordability_separation test: For a PPP/public procurement comparison, confirm the alternatives meet equivalent minimum service/output requirements, distinguish VfM from affordability, and reject 'cheapest = best' logic where service/value differs materially.

tier2.label: Identify whether the VfM analysis is an early screen, gateway, negotiation benchmark, bid sanity check or ex-durante/ex-post review.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's vfm_stage_purpose_and_comparator_currency test: Identify whether the VfM analysis is an early screen, gateway, negotiation benchmark, bid sanity check or ex-durante/ex-post review. Confirm the comparator is current enough for that purpose and has been updated where scope, timing, market pricing or risk allocation changed.

tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's vfm_nonvalued_effects test: Where the governing VfM methodology includes qualitative/non-valued effects, identify material performance, flexibility, competition, deliverability or other effects not monetised and explain how they influence the decision. Do not omit them or assign arbitrary cash values solely to force an NPV result.

Do not import another jurisdiction's discount-rate convention.

tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's vfm_competition_bid_sanity test: Where procurement-stage VfM relies on competition or a bid sanity check, assess the quality of market tension and compare final bids to the appropriate updated reference/conventional option. Flag a stale or uncompetitive benchmark as weak evidence rather than proof of VfM.

tier2.label: For a live authority-pays PPP, reproduce current periodic payment from base payment through indexation, availability/performance adjustments, pass-throughs/true-ups, compensation events and invoice timing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_operational_payment_model test: For a live authority-pays PPP, reproduce current periodic payment from base payment through indexation, availability/performance adjustments, pass-throughs/true-ups, compensation events and invoice timing. tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_operational_userpay_sustainability_and_review test: For a live user-pay PPP with tariff resets, profit/revenue sharing or financial-equilibrium mechanisms, use actual demand/tariff history and current forecasts to reproduce the contract's review/reset mechanics and test long-run concession sustainability.

tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_periodic_healthcheck_savings_and_insurance test: Where periodic contract review applies, test technical/financial/legal performance, market-testing/benchmarking only where contractually appropriate, refinancing/insurance opportunities and whether proposed savings preserve maintenance, lifecycle, service quality and handback.

tier2.label: For material PPP changes, trace the full direct and knock-on consequences, assess cumulative amendments since signature and identify the actual source/obligation for incremental financing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_change_cumulative_impact_and_financing test: For material PPP changes, trace the full direct and knock-on consequences, assess cumulative amendments since signature and identify the actual source/obligation for incremental financing. Do not assume the original debt package can fund later capex.

tier2.label: For expiry/termination, test service continuity, technical/remedial plan, information/staff transfer where applicable, final settlement and the security for late-life remedial/handback obligations.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_end_contract_liability_security test: For expiry/termination, test service continuity, technical/remedial plan, information/staff transfer where applicable, final settlement and the security for late-life remedial/handback obligations. tier2.label: For a road/highway PPP, confirm model depth matches the decision stage and separate investment subsidy from operating subsidy.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's road_model_maturity_and_subsidy_boundary test: For a road/highway PPP, confirm model depth matches the decision stage and separate investment subsidy from operating subsidy. tier2.label: For geothermal project finance, establish whether commercial resource confirmation/testing is sufficient for the assumed debt stage.

tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's geothermal_resource_well_plant_capacity_bridge test: Bridge reservoir/resource potential to production/injection well capacity, steam/fluid gathering, plant gross output, auxiliary/losses and net metered PPA capacity/energy. tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's geothermal_well_productivity_and_capex_scope test: Where material, reconcile required output to well productivity, production/injection well count, drilling/gathering/interconnection scope and future field reinvestment.
