tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's geothermal_capacity_energy_tariff test: Where the PPA separates capacity and energy charges, link capacity payment to contractually available/accepted capacity and energy payment to net dispatched/delivered energy and actual variable components. Apply weighting, indexation, availability and penalty mechanics and avoid a generic thermal-fuel pass-through where inapplicable.

tier2.label: For a geothermal/IPP project with one material PPA payer, distinguish demand protection from counterparty payment risk.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's geothermal_offtaker_credit_concentration test: For a geothermal/IPP project with one material PPA payer, distinguish demand protection from counterparty payment risk. Reconcile PPA exposure to utility credit enhancement, sovereign support, LC/liquidity support and their expiry/call mechanics.

tier2.label: For a project that depends on unproven or early-commercial technology, identify the actual engineering/technology maturity at the model date and reconcile the precision of capex, schedule, performance and financing as...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_project_maturity_stage test: For a project that depends on unproven or early-commercial technology, identify the actual engineering/technology maturity at the model date and reconcile the precision of capex, schedule, performance and financing assumptions to that maturity. Flag lender-grade certainty supported only by conceptual or early pilot evidence.

tier2.label: Trace each material technology cash-flow driver — throughput, yield, quality, uptime, efficiency, degradation or analogous KPI — to representative test, pilot, demonstration, guarantee or operating evidence.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_physical_kpi_evidence_bridge test: Trace each material technology cash-flow driver — throughput, yield, quality, uptime, efficiency, degradation or analogous KPI — to representative test, pilot, demonstration, guarantee or operating evidence. Distinguish measured performance from extrapolated commercial assumptions.

tier2.label: For FOAK or early-NOAK assets, compare the scale and integration of demonstrated operation with the proposed commercial plant.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's foak_scaleup_and_integration_gap test: For FOAK or early-NOAK assets, compare the scale and integration of demonstrated operation with the proposed commercial plant. Identify unsupported scale-up steps, untested unit-operation interfaces and assumptions that treat component success as full-system performance.

tier2.label: Reconcile the current capex and contingency to the actual engineering definition and supplier/EPC evidence.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_cost_estimate_maturity test: Reconcile the current capex and contingency to the actual engineering definition and supplier/EPC evidence. A late-stage financing case should not retain a precise early estimate when FEED, site integration or major equipment pricing remains unresolved.

tier2.label: Assess whether engineering, site/permits, supply/offtake contracts, O&M, insurance and financing have matured consistently.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technical_commercial_finance_maturity_convergence test: Assess whether engineering, site/permits, supply/offtake contracts, O&M, insurance and financing have matured consistently. Flag a project that is technically advanced but commercially unsupported, or commercially contracted before the technical design can credibly meet the contract.

tier2.label: Classify each material contract as discussion, LOI/MOU, term sheet, binding offer or executed agreement and test whether the model applies rights that exist only in later-form documents.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_contract_maturity_matrix test: Classify each material contract as discussion, LOI/MOU, term sheet, binding offer or executed agreement and test whether the model applies rights that exist only in later-form documents. Pay particular attention to termination, price, liability, assignment and credit-support terms.

tier2.label: For a stand-alone project-finance case, identify material parent/SPV linkages including cross-default, affiliate contracts, cash pooling, shared liabilities, IP/O&M dependence and reorganisation rights.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_entity_separateness_and_parent_linkage test: For a stand-alone project-finance case, identify material parent/SPV linkages including cross-default, affiliate contracts, cash pooling, shared liabilities, IP/O&M dependence and reorganisation rights. Do not infer bankruptcy remoteness from the SPV label alone.

tier2.label: For the construction package, map design, price, schedule, technology, integration and performance risk to the executed/expected EPC terms.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_epc_actual_risk_allocation test: For the construction package, map design, price, schedule, technology, integration and performance risk to the executed/expected EPC terms. Ignore the EPC/LSTK/GMP/EPCM label where exclusions, change rights, liability caps or weak security materially alter the supposed wrap.

tier2.label: Where feedstock/resource is material, reconcile contracted quantity, quality/specification, price, logistics, substitution and supplier credit to the process assumptions.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's feedstock_supply_specification_and_process_fit test: Where feedstock/resource is material, reconcile contracted quantity, quality/specification, price, logistics, substitution and supplier credit to the process assumptions. Test the cash effect of off-spec, unavailable or replacement feedstock rather than stressing price alone.

tier2.label: For specialist equipment outside the core EPC, identify responsibility for design integration, delivery, commissioning, warranty and performance.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's equipment_supplier_epc_interface test: For specialist equipment outside the core EPC, identify responsibility for design integration, delivery, commissioning, warranty and performance. Flag any gap where supplier and EPC warranties are individually valid but no party is responsible for integrated output.

tier2.label: For technology-performance insurance or guarantees, trace trigger, deductible, exclusions, cap, policy term, claim timing and use of proceeds.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_insurance_and_recovery_perimeter test: For technology-performance insurance or guarantees, trace trigger, deductible, exclusions, cap, policy term, claim timing and use of proceeds. Prevent full double recovery from EPC LDs, warranty, insurance and other credit support unless the contracts explicitly permit it.

tier2.label: Before financial close, map remaining FEED, pilot, site, permitting, adviser, diligence and other development costs to committed development capital.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_development_budget_and_funding test: Before financial close, map remaining FEED, pilot, site, permitting, adviser, diligence and other development costs to committed development capital. Do not use permanent project debt before it is legally available or assume every sunk sponsor cost is reimbursable.

tier2.label: Where debt remains uncommitted, compare required quantum, tenor, currency and risk acceptance with current project-specific lender/market evidence.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's financing_source_project_fit test: Where debt remains uncommitted, compare required quantum, tenor, currency and risk acceptance with current project-specific lender/market evidence. Historical market ranges or the theoretical existence of a financing product are not proof of executable capital.

tier2.label: Where multiple equity classes or strategic investors exist, reconcile capital, preferred rights, control, dilution, distribution priority and affiliate commercial benefits.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_equity_rights_and_strategic_economics test: Where multiple equity classes or strategic investors exist, reconcile capital, preferred rights, control, dilution, distribution priority and affiliate commercial benefits. A strategic investor's total economics may include EPC, equipment, feedstock, offtake, O&M or tax/incentive value beyond stated equity return.

tier2.label: For an operating PFI/availability PPP, compare authority deductions with the responsible subcontractor's liability and liability cap.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's pfi_deduction_passdown_liability_cap test: For an operating PFI/availability PPP, compare authority deductions with the responsible subcontractor's liability and liability cap. Quantify the portion that remains at SPV level after caps, exclusions and recovery timing.

tier2.label: For material operating defects, verify that D&C warranty/limitation rights, bond/guarantee and contractor solvency still support the assumed recovery.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's latent_construction_defect_recovery_tail test: For material operating defects, verify that D&C warranty/limitation rights, bond/guarantee and contractor solvency still support the assumed recovery. Flag recovery assumed after the relevant contractual or security period has expired.

tier2.label: Where deductions/remediation are disputed among service, lifecycle and construction parties, separate current cash outflow from ultimate legal/economic allocation.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's disputed_deduction_attribution_and_liquidity test: Where deductions/remediation are disputed among service, lifecycle and construction parties, separate current cash outflow from ultimate legal/economic allocation. Test whether the SPV can remain liquid while responsibility is unresolved.

tier2.label: For a project nearing expiry, compare credible remaining lifecycle/handback/remediation cost with restricted lifecycle funding, remaining project cash and legally available sponsor/support value.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's lifecycle_handback_distress_capacity test: For a project nearing expiry, compare credible remaining lifecycle/handback/remediation cost with restricted lifecycle funding, remaining project cash and legally available sponsor/support value. Flag a late-life funding gap even if historic investor IRR is strong.

tier2.label: If a service provider may fail or be terminated, model replacement procurement, mobilisation, price premium, temporary deductions, transition cost and recovery/security.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's service_provider_replacement_distress_cost test: If a service provider may fail or be terminated, model replacement procurement, mobilisation, price premium, temporary deductions, transition cost and recovery/security. Do not replace the provider instantaneously at the original contract price.

tier2.label: In a distress case, identify committed versus merely possible sponsor funding.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's limited_recourse_no_automatic_rescue_equity test: In a distress case, identify committed versus merely possible sponsor funding. Do not inject unlimited equity to avoid insolvency unless that support is contractually committed or is an explicitly labelled rescue scenario.

tier2.label: For a live PFI/PPP, distinguish the contractual financial-close/base-case model from the current lender/operational model and any shareholder return model.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's contract_model_vs_lender_operating_model test: For a live PFI/PPP, distinguish the contractual financial-close/base-case model from the current lender/operational model and any shareholder return model. Use the current operating model for solvency/covenant assessment while preserving the contract model for calculations that require it.

tier2.label: Calculate or inspect remaining future shareholder cash flows and committed sponsor support rather than relying only on lifetime IRR.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's remaining_shareholder_value_as_shock_absorber test: Calculate or inspect remaining future shareholder cash flows and committed sponsor support rather than relying only on lifetime IRR. Low remaining distributions can reduce rescue incentives and available economic headroom.

tier2.label: Challenge a project presented as financially healthy because investor IRR remains high after earlier dividends/refinancing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's historic_irr_not_forward_distress_capacity test: Challenge a project presented as financially healthy because investor IRR remains high after earlier dividends/refinancing. Test current liquidity, remaining shareholder value, reserves, lifecycle and debt headroom independently.

tier2.label: Compare actual DSRA, lifecycle/MRA and other reserve balances with finance-document targets and replenishment rules.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's reserve_underfunding_distress_signal test: Compare actual DSRA, lifecycle/MRA and other reserve balances with finance-document targets and replenishment rules. Treat a reserve shortfall as a potential stress signal and do not count unfunded reserve cash as unrestricted strength.

tier2.label: Where lender reports are available, identify waiver requests, default notices, covenant certificates, material-adverse-effect notices and restructuring activity.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's lender_waiver_default_and_reporting_signals test: Where lender reports are available, identify waiver requests, default notices, covenant certificates, material-adverse-effect notices and restructuring activity. A waiver changes the immediate remedy, not the underlying economics, unless its terms genuinely cure the issue.

tier2.label: For an operating project in material stress, reconcile going-concern disclosures, provisions, overdue liabilities, auditor comments and reporting delays to the current model.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's statutory_accounts_distress_reconciliation test: For an operating project in material stress, reconcile going-concern disclosures, provisions, overdue liabilities, auditor comments and reporting delays to the current model. Investigate material uncertainty in accounts that is absent from the lender/operating forecast.

tier2.label: For serious PFI distress, quantify the service-continuity and financial effect of full contractual deductions versus any proposed temporary suspension/settlement/cure strategy.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's authority_deduction_distress_strategy test: For serious PFI distress, quantify the service-continuity and financial effect of full contractual deductions versus any proposed temporary suspension/settlement/cure strategy. Preserve contractual rights and do not assume maximum immediate deductions necessarily maximise authority value.

tier2.label: Where a road model solves operating subsidy to a target ADSCR/DSCR, classify the output as a funding-gap diagnostic unless government support is legally and fiscally committed.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's road_automatic_subsidy_is_not_commitment test: Where a road model solves operating subsidy to a target ADSCR/DSCR, classify the output as a funding-gap diagnostic unless government support is legally and fiscally committed. Quantify the support requirement and replace the plug with the actual support mechanism for a bankability case.

tier2.label: Reconcile vehicle-class traffic, class tolls, discounts/exemptions and collection to revenue, and connect traffic to material variable operating cost.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's road_vehicle_class_toll_and_cost_bridge test: Reconcile vehicle-class traffic, class tolls, discounts/exemptions and collection to revenue, and connect traffic to material variable operating cost. Do not use one blended traffic × tariff calculation where class economics are material.

tier2.label: Distinguish annual accounting expense/accrual from actual periodic resurfacing or major-maintenance cash.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's road_periodic_heavy_maintenance_cash_timing test: Distinguish annual accounting expense/accrual from actual periodic resurfacing or major-maintenance cash. Confirm the financing/reserve can meet the cash requirement in the intervention year.

tier2.label: For an authority road case, separately show investment/operating subsidies, toll-related taxes/fees and retained public costs/support.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's road_public_authority_cashflow_perimeter test: For an authority road case, separately show investment/operating subsidies, toll-related taxes/fees and retained public costs/support. Do not infer public value from tax receipts while omitting contingent guarantees or service obligations.

tier2.label: Reject legacy teaching-model insolvency tests or fixed IRR/coverage hurdles as universal rules.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's road_distress_threshold_jurisdiction_specific test: Reject legacy teaching-model insolvency tests or fixed IRR/coverage hurdles as universal rules. Apply the actual concession, financing and local legal/financial-distress framework.

tier2.label: For a concession combining an existing terminal with new-build or rehabilitation, separate operating revenue, construction/rehab outages, migration and new-terminal COD.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's port_existing_new_terminal_phasing test: For a concession combining an existing terminal with new-build or rehabilitation, separate operating revenue, construction/rehab outages, migration and new-terminal COD. Test cannibalisation and common-cost/capacity allocation.

tier2.label: Where material, segment gateway/transshipment and full/empty container flows and apply the correct handling/storage tariff, index and customer discount.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's port_container_mix_tariff_discount test: Where material, segment gateway/transshipment and full/empty container flows and apply the correct handling/storage tariff, index and customer discount. Prevent a transshipment discount from reducing unrelated traffic.

tier2.label: Reconcile core staffing and traffic-linked variable labour to throughput and operating windows, preserving relevant local/foreign currency exposures.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's port_fixed_variable_labour_and_currency test: Reconcile core staffing and traffic-linked variable labour to throughput and operating windows, preserving relevant local/foreign currency exposures. Throughput growth with flat labour cost requires evidenced productivity/spare capacity.

tier2.label: Decompose port authority payments into fixed rent, indexed components, throughput fee, revenue royalty, minimum guarantee or other actual bases.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's port_concession_fee_components test: Decompose port authority payments into fixed rent, indexed components, throughput fee, revenue royalty, minimum guarantee or other actual bases. Stress fixed versus variable components correctly in a throughput downside.

tier2.label: Where export-credit/ECA debt, a trustee/DSRA and revolving liquidity coexist, test each instrument's distinct eligibility, restriction and repayment mechanics.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's port_eca_trustee_and_revolver_separation test: Where export-credit/ECA debt, a trustee/DSRA and revolving liquidity coexist, test each instrument's distinct eligibility, restriction and repayment mechanics. Do not count restricted debt-service cash as working capital or an ECA facility as general-purpose funding.

tier2.label: If a sponsor is also EPC contractor, equipment supplier or operator, separate SPV project economics from sponsor-group EPC/O&M/equipment margin and equity/shareholder-loan return.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's port_related_party_contractor_sponsor_return test: If a sponsor is also EPC contractor, equipment supplier or operator, separate SPV project economics from sponsor-group EPC/O&M/equipment margin and equity/shareholder-loan return. Test related-party pricing and avoid double-counting affiliate value.

tier2.label: For proprietary technology, verify that project/lender rights to the IP, documentation and technical support survive the relevant sponsor default/step-in scenario for the needed period.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_ip_stepin_and_operating_continuity test: For proprietary technology, verify that project/lender rights to the IP, documentation and technical support survive the relevant sponsor default/step-in scenario for the needed period. Physical ownership of equipment is not sufficient if operation legally or practically depends on terminated IP rights.

tier2.label: A high project or equity IRR does not prove technology-project financeability.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_bankability_not_project_irr_only test: A high project or equity IRR does not prove technology-project financeability. Reconcile return to demonstrated performance, contract maturity, counterparty credit, construction wrap, liquidity and debt-market fit.

tier2.label: Compare firm offtake term, termination/cure, renewal notice and replacement lead time with debt maturity/average life.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's offtake_term_vs_debt_and_replacement test: Compare firm offtake term, termination/cure, renewal notice and replacement lead time with debt maturity/average life. Flag debt reliance on an uncommitted contract tail or optimistic renewal.

tier2.label: At financial close or FID, confirm LOI/MOU/term-sheet assumptions have been replaced by executed contract and financing terms where available.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's term_sheet_to_financial_close_assumption_convergence test: At financial close or FID, confirm LOI/MOU/term-sheet assumptions have been replaced by executed contract and financing terms where available. Quantify any value or coverage change caused by final liability, price, schedule, hedge or reserve terms.

tier2.label: Run at least one coherent technology-project downside linking physical underperformance to commercial and financing consequences, including applicable recoveries and caps.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's technology_downside_causal_combination test: Run at least one coherent technology-project downside linking physical underperformance to commercial and financing consequences, including applicable recoveries and caps. Avoid isolated sensitivities that never test the interaction between yield/availability, contracts, liquidity and debt.

tier2.label: For a distressed operating PPP, combine forward coverage, reserve funding, remaining shareholder value, lifecycle/handback exposure, material disputes, subcontractor credit and lender/going-concern evidence into an in...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's pfi_financial_stress_early_warning_composite test: For a distressed operating PPP, combine forward coverage, reserve funding, remaining shareholder value, lifecycle/handback exposure, material disputes, subcontractor credit and lender/going-concern evidence into an integrated assessment. Do not declare the project healthy or insolvent from one ratio or one accounting metric.

tier2.label: For an early-stage PPP scoping model, bridge required service/output and rough whole-life/project-finance cost to the approximate revenue requirement, then test feasible user charges, public payments and support.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_reverse_revenue_requirement_scoping test: For an early-stage PPP scoping model, bridge required service/output and rough whole-life/project-finance cost to the approximate revenue requirement, then test feasible user charges, public payments and support. Treat the exercise as a gap diagnostic, not a revenue plug to an investor return, and replace illustrative ratios/returns as project evidence matures.

tier2.label: Where the model supports project selection rather than only an executed contract, reconcile the preferred PPP scope against the applicable do-minimum/defer/rehabilitate and materially different technical/site alternat...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_do_minimum_and_technical_alternatives test: Where the model supports project selection rather than only an executed contract, reconcile the preferred PPP scope against the applicable do-minimum/defer/rehabilitate and materially different technical/site alternatives. Confirm the financial case does not assume the selected solution is necessary before service-equivalent options are screened.

tier2.label: Identify material retained-authority or third-party enabling works such as access roads, utilities, grid/network reinforcement, land or intermodal connections.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_enabling_infrastructure_funding_boundary test: Identify material retained-authority or third-party enabling works such as access roads, utilities, grid/network reinforcement, land or intermodal connections. Reconcile owner, funding, completion date and contractual delay consequence to project COD/demand; do not show the SPV as fully deliverable if an essential external work has no credible funded path.

tier2.label: For material legal, lender or contractual environmental/social obligations, trace assessment/mitigation/compensation/monitoring requirements into project capex, opex, land, programme and financing conditions.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_environmental_social_cost_schedule_bridge test: For material legal, lender or contractual environmental/social obligations, trace assessment/mitigation/compensation/monitoring requirements into project capex, opex, land, programme and financing conditions. Do not import another jurisdiction's thresholds; use the actual applicable requirement.

tier2.label: Where a permit, community/land consent or safeguard approval gates site access, debt draw, construction or operation, confirm the model timing and downside reflect the unresolved status and cure path rather than assum...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_consent_permit_financing_dependency test: Where a permit, community/land consent or safeguard approval gates site access, debt draw, construction or operation, confirm the model timing and downside reflect the unresolved status and cure path rather than assuming unconditional approval on the base date.

tier2.label: Where sponsor affiliates provide EPC, O&M, management, supply or other project services, separate the SPV payment/cost from affiliate margin and sponsor investment return.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_related_party_operator_contractor_economics test: Where sponsor affiliates provide EPC, O&M, management, supply or other project services, separate the SPV payment/cost from affiliate margin and sponsor investment return. Reconcile related-party pricing/approval requirements and correlated sponsor-counterparty risk; prevent the same affiliate economics being counted as both project saving and extra return.

tier2.label: Where a model claims maximum or optimal leverage, identify the binding DSCR/LLCR, maturity/tail, minimum-equity, completion-support, rating, market-capacity, reserve or other financing constraint.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_constrained_gearing_selection test: Where a model claims maximum or optimal leverage, identify the binding DSCR/LLCR, maturity/tail, minimum-equity, completion-support, rating, market-capacity, reserve or other financing constraint. Confirm the chosen structure lies in a feasible financing set rather than maximising debt percentage mechanically.

tier2.label: For a genuine bank-versus-bond financing comparison, reconcile construction draw/prefunding, negative carry, coupon/IDC, amortisation flexibility, reserves/covenants, maturity, rating/trustee costs, prepayment/breakag...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_bank_vs_bond_cash_timing test: For a genuine bank-versus-bond financing comparison, reconcile construction draw/prefunding, negative carry, coupon/IDC, amortisation flexibility, reserves/covenants, maturity, rating/trustee costs, prepayment/breakage and refinancing/termination effects. Compare all-in cash economics, not headline coupon alone.

tier2.label: Where debt is inflation/index linked, reconcile its index, base/reset lag, coupon and principal accretion to the revenue index/reset, O&M/lifecycle inflation and amortisation.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_index_linked_debt_basis_and_accretion test: Where debt is inflation/index linked, reconcile its index, base/reset lag, coupon and principal accretion to the revenue index/reset, O&M/lifecycle inflation and amortisation. Under material inflation cases confirm debt fully repays and distributions do not leak cash needed for accreted principal.

tier2.label: Where a guarantee, wrap or bond insurance is used, identify covered events/amounts/periods, guarantor credit/call conditions, fees and related obligations, then reconcile the actual improvement in pricing, tenor, debt...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_credit_wrap_value_and_scope test: Where a guarantee, wrap or bond insurance is used, identify covered events/amounts/periods, guarantor credit/call conditions, fees and related obligations, then reconcile the actual improvement in pricing, tenor, debt capacity or market access. Do not treat partial-risk/political-risk cover as an all-risk guarantee.

tier2.label: Where financing is Sharia-compliant or asset/profit based, model the executed ownership, purchase/resale, lease/rental, profit-share or redemption cash flows and their ranking/security rather than converting them into...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_sharia_asset_based_cashflow_perimeter test: Where financing is Sharia-compliant or asset/profit based, model the executed ownership, purchase/resale, lease/rental, profit-share or redemption cash flows and their ranking/security rather than converting them into a generic interest line. Reconcile construction, tax/transfer and early-termination consequences to the actual documents.

tier2.label: For a project lease/asset-finance structure, identify legal owner, lessee rights, rent, purchase option/residual value and end-of-term transfer.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_project_lease_residual_handback test: For a project lease/asset-finance structure, identify legal owner, lessee rights, rent, purchase option/residual value and end-of-term transfer. Confirm terminal sale/purchase proceeds do not conflict with project-agreement handback and that insurance/maintenance/termination cash follows the party bearing the risk.

tier2.label: Where sponsor capital includes ordinary equity, shareholder/subordinated debt or preferred instruments, preserve instrument-specific advances, service/redemption and ranking in sponsor returns.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_finance_blended_sponsor_capital_return test: Where sponsor capital includes ordinary equity, shareholder/subordinated debt or preferred instruments, preserve instrument-specific advances, service/redemption and ranking in sponsor returns. Explain any headline equity-IRR uplift through the full sponsor cash-flow bridge rather than treating it as project-level value creation.

tier2.label: Where the contract calculates refinancing gain from projected sponsor distributions with and without the refinancing, use the same current pre-refinancing operating assumptions in both cases and the contract's valuati...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_refinancing_current_distribution_npv_bridge test: Where the contract calculates refinancing gain from projected sponsor distributions with and without the refinancing, use the same current pre-refinancing operating assumptions in both cases and the contract's valuation/discount basis. Include only permitted costs/effects and prevent double counting of equity, shareholder debt and transaction costs.

tier2.label: Where refinancing reduces sponsor equity exposure or produces immediate cash extraction, apply any special contractual sharing/consent rule and reproduce material authority information/model-audit rights.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's ppp_refinancing_equity_extraction_and_audit_rights test: Where refinancing reduces sponsor equity exposure or produces immediate cash extraction, apply any special contractual sharing/consent rule and reproduce material authority information/model-audit rights. Do not use an ordinary gain-share formula if the contract treats early degearing/extraction differently.

tier2.label: For a hospital/health PPP, classify building/lifecycle, equipment, clinical staff, administration, ancillary services, IT, procurement and billing responsibilities by party.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_ppp_scope_and_responsibility_boundary test: For a hospital/health PPP, classify building/lifecycle, equipment, clinical staff, administration, ancillary services, IT, procurement and billing responsibilities by party. Confirm the financial model charges and revenues follow that scope and does not assume every hospital PPP is project-financed or privately operated end-to-end.

tier2.label: For a demand-exposed hospital model, bridge catchment/demographics/disease/referrals/competition to inpatient, outpatient, diagnostics/procedures, length of stay, capacity and payer/case mix.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_demand_case_mix_and_capacity test: For a demand-exposed hospital model, bridge catchment/demographics/disease/referrals/competition to inpatient, outpatient, diagnostics/procedures, length of stay, capacity and payer/case mix. Do not use one bed-occupancy assumption as proof of all activity or revenue.

tier2.label: Separate self-pay, insurer, public-payer, grant/service-payment and uncompensated-care cash.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_payer_reimbursement_working_capital test: Separate self-pay, insurer, public-payer, grant/service-payment and uncompensated-care cash. For material claim payers, model eligibility, submission/denial/return and cash lag into receivables and liquidity; do not equate recognised reimbursement revenue with immediate cash.

tier2.label: Identify whether the hospital private party earns management fee, cost reimbursement, case/activity payment, mark-up, revenue/profit share, availability payment or a hybrid.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_payment_compensation_mechanism test: Identify whether the hospital private party earns management fee, cost reimbursement, case/activity payment, mark-up, revenue/profit share, availability payment or a hybrid. Reproduce eligible revenue/cost and true-up rules and prevent mutually exclusive bid options or overlapping fees/shares from being paid together.

tier2.label: Where the private scope includes hospital management, reconcile administration, staffing, drug/supply inventory and medical-equipment availability to clinical service capacity and quality.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_clinical_administrative_equipment_interface test: Where the private scope includes hospital management, reconcile administration, staffing, drug/supply inventory and medical-equipment availability to clinical service capacity and quality. Challenge cost savings that leave service, accreditation and revenue unchanged despite reduced critical inputs.

tier2.label: Map material operating licences, specialty/professional and payer/insurer accreditations to renewal dates, responsible party and the services/reimbursements they enable.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_licensing_accreditation_revenue_eligibility test: Map material operating licences, specialty/professional and payer/insurer accreditations to renewal dates, responsible party and the services/reimbursements they enable. Confirm a lapse has the correct service, cost and revenue consequence rather than full operations continuing automatically.

tier2.label: Where a PPP changes the employment model, bridge existing staff into retained, transferred, redeployed, retired or rehired categories, including transition/severance/recruitment/training cost where applicable.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_staff_transition_and_double_count test: Where a PPP changes the employment model, bridge existing staff into retained, transferred, redeployed, retired or rehired categories, including transition/severance/recruitment/training cost where applicable. Prevent legacy public payroll and full private replacement payroll from both remaining unless both are genuinely incurred.

tier2.label: For hospital KPIs used in the PPP contract, map evidence/measurement to threshold, cure/remediation and payment/default/accreditation effect.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_contract_performance_monitoring_financial_link test: For hospital KPIs used in the PPP contract, map evidence/measurement to threshold, cure/remediation and payment/default/accreditation effect. Do not invent penalties for clinical metrics outside the contract, but do not leave contract-linked quality failures as financially inert dashboard items.

tier2.label: Where the PPP covers multiple hospitals, reconcile shared procurement/overhead, central services, referrals and capacity transfers across facilities.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_system_internal_flow_and_scale test: Where the PPP covers multiple hospitals, reconcile shared procurement/overhead, central services, referrals and capacity transfers across facilities. Prevent internal transfers from being counted as new system demand and confirm receiving-site capacity/cost responds to service reallocation.

tier2.label: For a health PPP justified by service/access outcomes, keep public-health need separate from billable private demand.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's hospital_public_health_need_vs_private_revenue test: For a health PPP justified by service/access outcomes, keep public-health need separate from billable private demand. Where tariffs are unaffordable or reimbursement is insufficient, expose the actual subsidy/service-payment/funding requirement rather than plugging patient charges to meet investor return.

tier2.label: For social/affordable/student housing treated as infrastructure, classify development-sale, rental, availability-supported or mixed tenure.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's social_housing_revenue_structure_and_unit_perimeter test: For social/affordable/student housing treated as infrastructure, classify development-sale, rental, availability-supported or mixed tenure. Trace units/beds through availability, occupancy, rent/fees, concessions/arrears and collection; prevent sold units from continuing to earn rent absent a genuine leaseback/management right.

tier2.label: Where project and holdco debt coexist, reconcile project covenant/reserve/distribution capacity to cash actually available upstream for holdco service.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's project_vs_holdco_debt_structural_subordination test: Where project and holdco debt coexist, reconcile project covenant/reserve/distribution capacity to cash actually available upstream for holdco service. Do not use holdco debt to improve SPV bankability, and model the holdco downside when project distributions are locked or delayed.

tier2.label: Identify the traffic forecast's purpose, date and maturity: pre-feasibility, authority procurement case, bidder case, lender/investment-grade case or operating update.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_forecast_maturity_stage test: Identify the traffic forecast's purpose, date and maturity: pre-feasibility, authority procurement case, bidder case, lender/investment-grade case or operating update. Confirm the financial model does not rely on an early screening forecast as if it had transaction-grade survey, model-validation and due-diligence support.

tier2.label: Decompose material traffic into existing, reassigned, diverted/capture, underlying growth, development, induced and other network/policy effects where supported by the traffic study.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_forecast_building_block_bridge test: Decompose material traffic into existing, reassigned, diverted/capture, underlying growth, development, induced and other network/policy effects where supported by the traffic study. Check that future traffic components are not double counted and that the financial model preserves the traffic study's economic perimeter.

tier2.label: For a greenfield/materially changed road, isolate opening-day/in-scope demand from long-term speculative growth.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_opening_day_bankable_traffic test: For a greenfield/materially changed road, isolate opening-day/in-scope demand from long-term speculative growth. Test whether early debt service depends on currently observable/capturable traffic or on later development/induced demand that cannot reasonably support the first debt-service periods.

tier2.label: Review the traffic study's classified counts, O-D, travel-time and network surveys, survey timing/duration and annualisation.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_survey_program_annualisation test: Review the traffic study's classified counts, O-D, travel-time and network surveys, survey timing/duration and annualisation. Challenge known holiday, event, tourism-season, construction or abnormal-weather observations being extrapolated to a normal year without a credible adjustment or longer-duration benchmark.

tier2.label: Where a travel-demand model is material, reconcile trip matrices and network demand by relevant vehicle/user class and time slice.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_trip_matrix_vehicle_time_segments test: Where a travel-demand model is material, reconcile trip matrices and network demand by relevant vehicle/user class and time slice. Confirm the forecast does not collapse materially different peak/off-peak, car/heavy-vehicle or origin-destination behaviour into one aggregate that changes toll capture or revenue.

tier2.label: Inspect evidence that the travel-demand model represents material competing routes, speeds, capacities, junctions and travel times and has been calibrated/validated appropriately.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_network_model_validation test: Inspect evidence that the travel-demand model represents material competing routes, speeds, capacities, junctions and travel times and has been calibrated/validated appropriately. Flag a model described as validated only against the same observations used to force calibration or with material residual mismatch left unexplained.

tier2.label: Where traffic capture is based on route choice, reconcile travel time, value of time, vehicle operating cost, toll and any supported reliability/safety/convenience effect to the project's alternatives.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_generalized_cost_capture test: Where traffic capture is based on route choice, reconcile travel time, value of time, vehicle operating cost, toll and any supported reliability/safety/convenience effect to the project's alternatives. Confirm the resulting capture/diversion logic is economically consistent with the toll-road benefit offered to each material user group.

tier2.label: For material willingness-to-pay assumptions, identify whether evidence is revealed preference, stated preference or another method; reconcile sample and segmentation to actual users; and test how the result enters tol...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_wtp_rp_sp_evidence test: For material willingness-to-pay assumptions, identify whether evidence is revealed preference, stated preference or another method; reconcile sample and segmentation to actual users; and test how the result enters toll-diversion/capture. Do not accept one unsupported average WTP as proof of demand across heterogeneous traffic classes.

tier2.label: Reconcile toll points, distance basis, class tariffs, discounts/exemptions, tax, payment method, escalation and timing between the traffic study and financial model.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_toll_strategy_capture_consistency test: Reconcile toll points, distance basis, class tariffs, discounts/exemptions, tax, payment method, escalation and timing between the traffic study and financial model. If the finance model changes the toll strategy materially, require a corresponding traffic response or an explicit documented assumption explaining why capture is unchanged.

tier2.label: Reconcile ramp-up depth and duration to greenfield/brownfield status, user awareness, opening readiness and comparable-project evidence.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_rampup_debt_overlap test: Reconcile ramp-up depth and duration to greenfield/brownfield status, user awareness, opening readiness and comparable-project evidence. Stress the periods where ramp-up overlaps peak debt balances and test reserve, liquidity, support, covenant and default consequences if ramp-up is slower than forecast.

tier2.label: For long-run traffic growth, identify material GDP/income, employment, population, car-ownership, fuel-price, mobility and land-use drivers.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_socioeconomic_driver_independence test: For long-run traffic growth, identify material GDP/income, employment, population, car-ownership, fuel-price, mobility and land-use drivers. Challenge double counting among correlated drivers, use of aspirational macro targets as base assumptions and transfer of short historical relationships unchanged across a multi-decade concession.

tier2.label: Where development or induced traffic is material, trace development status/timing and trip-generation assumptions separately from ordinary socio-economic growth and reassignment.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_development_induced_separation test: Where development or induced traffic is material, trace development status/timing and trip-generation assumptions separately from ordinary socio-economic growth and reassignment. Prevent the same trips being counted as development, induced and underlying growth or being assumed before the relevant development/access exists.

tier2.label: Reconcile the assumed opening, widening, deterioration, tolling or traffic-management of material competing and complementary infrastructure to the traffic forecast and contract.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_competing_complementary_timing test: Reconcile the assumed opening, widening, deterioration, tolling or traffic-management of material competing and complementary infrastructure to the traffic forecast and contract. Test correlated downside where a feeder/complementary project is late or a competing route improves earlier than expected.

tier2.label: For regulated/authority-approved toll increases, distinguish contractual formula from actual approval/political implementation risk.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_toll_policy_escalation_risk test: For regulated/authority-approved toll increases, distinguish contractual formula from actual approval/political implementation risk. Test delay, cap or non-implementation where credible rather than assuming every permitted toll escalation is automatically collected on the formula date.

tier2.label: Where tolls are local-currency but debt/cost or toll escalation has FX exposure, reconcile which party bears currency, convertibility and tariff-reset risk.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_fx_toll_currency_boundary test: Where tolls are local-currency but debt/cost or toll escalation has FX exposure, reconcile which party bears currency, convertibility and tariff-reset risk. Do not label traffic risk transferred if the private party is actually protected from traffic but exposed to an unmodelled FX/toll basis, or vice versa.

tier2.label: Where seasonal weather or climate hazards materially affect traffic, annualisation, road closure or competing-route availability, reflect the supported traffic and cash consequences separately from physical repair/ins...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_weather_climate_traffic_uncertainty test: Where seasonal weather or climate hazards materially affect traffic, annualisation, road closure or competing-route availability, reflect the supported traffic and cash consequences separately from physical repair/insurance effects. Challenge a climate-exposed road with weather-sensitive demand but no traffic-seasonality or disruption case.

tier2.label: Where credit resilience is material, run or review a discrete traffic/revenue shock for unforeseen events separately from the ordinary low case, so its effect can be identified.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_unforeseen_revenue_shock test: Where credit resilience is material, run or review a discrete traffic/revenue shock for unforeseen events separately from the ordinary low case, so its effect can be identified. Reconcile any force-majeure or supervening-event relief to the actual contract rather than assuming every demand shock is compensated.

tier2.label: For a material demand-risk forecast, compare key assumptions such as opening capture, ramp-up, growth and WTP with relevant external/outturn evidence.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_optimism_outside_view test: For a material demand-risk forecast, compare key assumptions such as opening capture, ramp-up, growth and WTP with relevant external/outturn evidence. Treat a strong inside-view forecast without comparable-project challenge as a risk indicator, not as an automatic error or a reason to impose a generic reference-class haircut.

tier2.label: Assess whether authority, bidder or sponsor incentives reward higher traffic forecasts through approval, concession fee, lower subsidy, winning bid or valuation.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_strategic_misrepresentation_incentive test: Assess whether authority, bidder or sponsor incentives reward higher traffic forecasts through approval, concession fee, lower subsidy, winning bid or valuation. Where the incentive is material, require independent due diligence and test whether financial viability survives a less aggressive traffic case.

tier2.label: For a procurement with high traffic uncertainty, assess whether the selection process could favour the most optimistic bidder and whether only projects with positively skewed forecasts survive screening.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_winners_survivors_curse test: For a procurement with high traffic uncertainty, assess whether the selection process could favour the most optimistic bidder and whether only projects with positively skewed forecasts survive screening. Test whether realism criteria, comparable evidence and financing commitment reduce these selection biases.

tier2.label: Where government is allocating material traffic risk, confirm it has a credible independent traffic benchmark or equivalent basis to evaluate bidder forecasts and public liabilities.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_public_forecast_benchmark test: Where government is allocating material traffic risk, confirm it has a credible independent traffic benchmark or equivalent basis to evaluate bidder forecasts and public liabilities. Reconcile any third-party/PPP-unit/public-financier review of the forecast to the assumptions used in the authority financial case.

tier2.label: Where a validated base-year travel-demand model is supplied to bidders, distinguish common observed/network inputs from bidder-owned future forecasts and assumptions.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_shared_baseyear_bidder_model test: Where a validated base-year travel-demand model is supplied to bidders, distinguish common observed/network inputs from bidder-owned future forecasts and assumptions. Do not treat use of the government base model as a guarantee of bidder future traffic, nor allow undisclosed post-bid model changes to escape comparison.

tier2.label: Where project debt relies on traffic, identify independent lender traffic-adviser work and the traffic case actually approved for credit.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_lender_traffic_adviser_case test: Where project debt relies on traffic, identify independent lender traffic-adviser work and the traffic case actually approved for credit. Reconcile debt sizing/covenants to the lender/debt case rather than automatically using the sponsor base case, and explain material traffic-case changes between bid and financial close.

tier2.label: Where procurement evaluates traffic-risk bids, test whether unusually high traffic forecasts are subject to realism checks/penalties or equivalent safeguards and whether multiple floating bid parameters obscure econom...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_bid_forecast_realism test: Where procurement evaluates traffic-risk bids, test whether unusually high traffic forecasts are subject to realism checks/penalties or equivalent safeguards and whether multiple floating bid parameters obscure economic comparison. Do not assume the highest concession fee or lowest subsidy is best if it is driven by unsupported demand.

tier2.label: Use asset type, trip mix, project need, user benefit, tolling history, connectivity, macro environment, development/network dependency, FX/toll stability, preparation quality, financier due diligence, legal enforceabi...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_traffic_risk_index_screen test: Use asset type, trip mix, project need, user benefit, tolling history, connectivity, macro environment, development/network dependency, FX/toll stability, preparation quality, financier due diligence, legal enforceability and bidder asymmetry as a qualitative traffic-risk screen. Do not convert illustrative scores or cut-offs into a probability of default or universal rating.

tier2.label: For an authority shadow-bid model, bridge authority traffic cases to toll/payment revenue, operating/lifecycle cost, CFADS, financing capacity, debt-service headroom, sponsor return and required toll/support/term.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_shadow_bid_financial_model test: For an authority shadow-bid model, bridge authority traffic cases to toll/payment revenue, operating/lifecycle cost, CFADS, financing capacity, debt-service headroom, sponsor return and required toll/support/term. Confirm the model is used to understand bankability/affordability rather than presented as a prediction of the winning bid.

tier2.label: For each material traffic low/base/high case, trace vehicle-class traffic through toll/payment revenue and CFADS into the actual DSCR/LLCR or lender metrics, reserve use, lock-up and default/cure path.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_scenario_credit_bridge test: For each material traffic low/base/high case, trace vehicle-class traffic through toll/payment revenue and CFADS into the actual DSCR/LLCR or lender metrics, reserve use, lock-up and default/cure path. Use transaction thresholds, not illustrative ratios from sector guidance.

tier2.label: Assess the selected road structure against risk transfer, bankability and user/government affordability simultaneously.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_structuring_nexus test: Assess the selected road structure against risk transfer, bankability and user/government affordability simultaneously. If the structure works only by transferring unmanageable traffic risk, imposing unaffordable toll/support or retaining excessive public exposure, test alternative scope/phasing/payment/risk-allocation options rather than a plug.

tier2.label: For an availability road, confirm private revenue is performance/availability based while any retained public toll/demand exposure remains on the authority side.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_availability_retained_traffic_risk test: For an availability road, confirm private revenue is performance/availability based while any retained public toll/demand exposure remains on the authority side. Test authority payment affordability and payment credit; do not claim traffic risk has disappeared merely because it is outside SPV revenue.

tier2.label: Where the private party earns both availability payment and toll revenue, reconcile each cash stream, offset/true-up, traffic exposure, government payment risk, toll-setting rights and upside sharing.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_blended_availability_structure test: Where the private party earns both availability payment and toll revenue, reconcile each cash stream, offset/true-up, traffic exposure, government payment risk, toll-setting rights and upside sharing. Classify the structure as hybrid rather than pure availability or full user-pay.

tier2.label: For shadow tolls, separate measured traffic risk borne by the private party from user-tariff, evasion, collection and currency risks retained by the authority.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_shadow_toll_traffic_revenue_split test: For shadow tolls, separate measured traffic risk borne by the private party from user-tariff, evasion, collection and currency risks retained by the authority. Where real tolls are also collected, keep authority user receipts distinct from contractual shadow-toll payments to the SPV.

tier2.label: Where shadow tolls use traffic bands, calculate marginal payment by band and test low/base/high traffic against both SPV debt/equity cash and authority affordability.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_shadow_toll_banding test: Where shadow tolls use traffic bands, calculate marginal payment by band and test low/base/high traffic against both SPV debt/equity cash and authority affordability. Do not replace a descending or nil upper-band structure with one average per-vehicle tariff.

tier2.label: Where an MRG is used, identify whether its purpose is to protect debt during opening/ramp-up or provide broader revenue support.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_mrg_early_debt_protection test: Where an MRG is used, identify whether its purpose is to protect debt during opening/ramp-up or provide broader revenue support. Reconcile floor, period/expiry and debt tenor so the model does not preserve full equity upside where the contract only provides a limited lender-oriented floor.

tier2.label: Stress the government's payment under the MRG using coherent low-traffic cases, aggregate caps and actual payment timing/credit.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_mrg_contingent_liability test: Stress the government's payment under the MRG using coherent low-traffic cases, aggregate caps and actual payment timing/credit. Report the support as a contingent fiscal exposure rather than free project revenue, and test payment risk if the authority/sovereign is financially constrained.

tier2.label: Where a revenue floor is paired with an upside share/cap, model both limbs, their common revenue definition, reference forecast, timing and true-up together.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_cap_collar_revenue_sharing test: Where a revenue floor is paired with an upside share/cap, model both limbs, their common revenue definition, reference forecast, timing and true-up together. Prevent downside support being included while the authority's contractual upside recovery is omitted.

tier2.label: For public/mezzanine or subordinated traffic-risk support, reconcile draw, ranking, deferral, repayment, pricing, intercreditor/security rights and downside loss.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_public_subordinated_support test: For public/mezzanine or subordinated traffic-risk support, reconcile draw, ranking, deferral, repayment, pricing, intercreditor/security rights and downside loss. Test whether it crowds in senior/private capital or merely substitutes public funding and whether grantor/investor role conflicts are managed.

tier2.label: For a full user-pay concession/lease, verify strong in-scope demand, WTP/user benefit, policy stability and downside resilience support genuine traffic-risk transfer.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_full_userpay_risk_transfer test: For a full user-pay concession/lease, verify strong in-scope demand, WTP/user benefit, policy stability and downside resilience support genuine traffic-risk transfer. For brownfield monetisation, compare the up-front concession value with the foregone public toll stream and challenge valuations dependent on aggressive traffic assumptions or expected renegotiation.

tier2.label: For a flexible-term/revenue-target road concession, reconcile cumulative-revenue target mechanics to the moving expiry date, senior debt maturity/tail, ramp-up liquidity, added-years lifecycle and handback.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_flexible_term_liquidity test: For a flexible-term/revenue-target road concession, reconcile cumulative-revenue target mechanics to the moving expiry date, senior debt maturity/tail, ramp-up liquidity, added-years lifecycle and handback. Confirm term extension does not falsely cure an early debt-service shortfall.

tier2.label: For an operating toll road, bridge actual-versus-forecast traffic/revenue into ramp-up, capture/toll, growth, development/induced, network, collection/policy and one-off variances where material.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_operating_outturn_reforecast test: For an operating toll road, bridge actual-versus-forecast traffic/revenue into ramp-up, capture/toll, growth, development/induced, network, collection/policy and one-off variances where material. Use the outturn to recalibrate future forecasts without rewriting the original historical forecast.

tier2.label: Trace the approved traffic study scenario/version through vehicle-class periodic traffic, ramp-up/growth, tolls/discounts/exemptions, chargeable transactions, cash collections, traffic-driven O&M/lifecycle/capacity an...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_traffic_study_financial_model_trace test: Trace the approved traffic study scenario/version through vehicle-class periodic traffic, ramp-up/growth, tolls/discounts/exemptions, chargeable transactions, cash collections, traffic-driven O&M/lifecycle/capacity and financing outputs. Identify any manual financial-model traffic overrides or post-study uplifts as separate assumptions requiring evidence and downside testing.

tier2.label: Where the traffic case uses toll elasticity, test both traffic and revenue response across the relevant toll range by material user class.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_toll_elasticity_revenue_curve test: Where the traffic case uses toll elasticity, test both traffic and revenue response across the relevant toll range by material user class. Challenge revenue optimisation that assumes one constant elasticity outside the evidence range or raises toll above the point where the traffic response makes revenue fall without showing that effect.

tier2.label: For a transaction-grade demand-risk road, confirm the traffic evidence package is proportionate to risk and includes the relevant survey/data report, base-year model, capture/diversion methodology, development/validat...
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_traffic_adviser_evidence_package test: For a transaction-grade demand-risk road, confirm the traffic evidence package is proportionate to risk and includes the relevant survey/data report, base-year model, capture/diversion methodology, development/validation evidence, forecast assumptions, annualisation/ramp-up, low/base/high cases, sensitivity ranking and due-diligence support. Do not impose illustrative survey durations or sample pe...

tier2.label: Where material O-D movements are synthetically filled through matrix estimation, compare prior and final matrices, trip lengths/ends and validation results.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's tollroad_matrix_estimation_bias test: Where material O-D movements are synthetically filled through matrix estimation, compare prior and final matrices, trip lengths/ends and validation results. Test whether synthetic trips or subsequent growth materially inflate project capture and treat heavy unobserved matrix filling as opening-day traffic risk rather than observed demand.

tier2.label: Reconstruct baseline/counterfactual utility or operating cost through ECM performance, verified savings, financing/ESCO payment and retained host benefit.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_economic_bargain test: Reconstruct baseline/counterfactual utility or operating cost through ECM performance, verified savings, financing/ESCO payment and retained host benefit. Confirm savings are not a free-standing revenue plug.

tier2.label: Test whether the pre-project baseline and reporting-period counterfactual reflect material weather, occupancy, production, operating-hours and facility changes using the agreed adjustment method.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_baseline_counterfactual test: Test whether the pre-project baseline and reporting-period counterfactual reflect material weather, occupancy, production, operating-hours and facility changes using the agreed adjustment method.

tier2.label: Classify the technical evidence from screening/benchmark through detailed or investment-grade audit and commissioning.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_audit_maturity test: Classify the technical evidence from screening/benchmark through detailed or investment-grade audit and commissioning. Confirm the evidence maturity is sufficient for the capital and financing decision being made.

tier2.label: Trace utility/meter data, equipment condition, O&M, operating schedules, site measurements, ECM costs and interactions into the model assumptions.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_evidence_package test: Trace utility/meter data, equipment condition, O&M, operating schedules, site measurements, ECM costs and interactions into the model assumptions. Identify unsupported savings assumptions or excluded measures.

tier2.label: Recalculate a sample adjusted baseline under the agreed M&V methodology and confirm reporting-period operating conditions are applied consistently without post-hoc bias.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_adjusted_baseline test: Recalculate a sample adjusted baseline under the agreed M&V methodology and confirm reporting-period operating conditions are applied consistently without post-hoc bias.

tier2.label: Map the contract's M&V protocol from actual use and approved adjustments through verified quantity and monetary savings, guarantee comparison, true-up and shortfall settlement.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_mandv_protocol test: Map the contract's M&V protocol from actual use and approved adjustments through verified quantity and monetary savings, guarantee comparison, true-up and shortfall settlement.

tier2.label: Bridge engineering energy savings to avoided tariff cost, contractual guaranteed savings, verified savings, cash available for payment and retained host benefit.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_savings_to_cash test: Bridge engineering energy savings to avoided tariff cost, contractual guaranteed savings, verified savings, cash available for payment and retained host benefit. Flag mismatched units/perimeters.

tier2.label: Determine whether the guarantee is in energy quantity or monetary savings and identify who bears tariff/commodity-price risk, including any floor/cap or valuation convention.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_energy_vs_dollar_guarantee test: Determine whether the guarantee is in energy quantity or monetary savings and identify who bears tariff/commodity-price risk, including any floor/cap or valuation convention.

tier2.label: For shared-savings arrangements, verify the sharing base, measurement frequency, allocation percentage, settlement timing, floor/cap and treatment of disputed/adjusted savings.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_shared_savings test: For shared-savings arrangements, verify the sharing base, measurement frequency, allocation percentage, settlement timing, floor/cap and treatment of disputed/adjusted savings.

tier2.label: Test whether bundled ECM savings account for interactions between measures rather than summing standalone estimates that share the same load reduction.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_ecm_interactions test: Test whether bundled ECM savings account for interactions between measures rather than summing standalone estimates that share the same load reduction.

tier2.label: Confirm savings, service payments and guarantees begin only when the applicable installation, commissioning, acceptance and operational triggers are satisfied.
tier2.fix_instruction: Investigate per skill-infrastructure.md's energy_efficiency_commissioning_savings_start test: Confirm savings, service payments and guarantees begin only when the applicable installation, commissioning, acceptance and operational triggers are satisfied.

tier2.label: Reconcile required O&M, training, monitoring and maintenance capability to the persistence of modeled savings and any ESCO guarantee obligations.
